review_text: It was OK. The staff was really friendly. With so many BBQ the price for the pulled pork sandwich was the same as most BBQ places. The flavor was OK nothing special.
Great food. Ribs are out of this world. Potato salad is outstanding. Friendly owners who care about the quality of their food and service. I have visited many times and will continue doing so.
The quality of the meat is great. The pulled pork and brisket were cooked perfectly. The sauce wasn't my cup of tea.

Ordered online for a large order via Door Dash, about 24 hours in advance of an imminent party.  I was informed less than an hour before the party that they wouldn't be fulfilling my order.  I didn't get the message until after the time the order was supposed to be delivered.  Incredibly poor customer service.  This is what they wrote:
"This email is to confirm your order has been cancelled and the order total has been fully refunded.  Please note this refund can take between 3-5 business days to complete, depending on your bank’s processing times. Feel free to contact us if there’s anything else we can help with."  Very very aggravating.

Anne-Marie was very kind welcoming and attentive to catering me. I had the Jamaican Salmon filet with mango salsa and side of bbq baked beans and it was delicious! Thank you so much. I will be back to try the rest of the menu.
Brisket is amazing, I'm a tough critic for the pork adn was not hugely impressed.  Tough parking lot, not entirely their fault.
Brisket is excellently cooked, potato salad is also particularly good.  Price is very reasonable for the quality food and casual environment.
Best Salmon in NOVA. Try the mango salsa!
I Support YHS business and very good BBQ. That is all.
Best BBQ nearby.  Brisket is very good.

They don't make there own sweet tea...  And that should summarize it for any southerner.

Brisket is Ok but not dry enough for Texas and not Smokey or tinder enough for anyone. (btw they aren't trying to be Texas bbq)

Beans are great!  Not sweet, but good, and have a little tiny bit of heat to them.

Pulled pork is tinder, but not Smokey.

Sauce is Carolina style, wet, and liquid like
Good enough Brisket and BBQ pork but not great. Down home feel.
Delicious BBQ and ribs on the weekend.
Awesome Food!
EVERYTHING ELSE

Title says it all. Big selection of combo lunches for less than $5.00 including canned soft drink. The place is clean and has seating for eat-in. In a store front at Old Fox Hill Rd and King St. Golden City Chinese Restaurant is a good place to quickly pickup some Chinese food. They have reasonably priced combination meals that include your entre, fried rice, and an egg roll.

Okay I totally love my regular place, but decided to check this one out. First off it took 2 hours for it to be delivered, no biggie I think if the food is amazing. Unfortunately that isnt the case. I got chicken lo mein...could barely find chicken, was dry. General Tso wasnt good at all and the fried rice  and white rice was like rocks...I dont like wasting food but I tried to eat it...very disappointed, threw it all away. I will definitely be sticking to my regular place.

Last night the food was delivered to my Hotel room with no problem...This afternoon, I place a order. I was informed the delivery may be an hour late...Well, one hour and fifteen minutes later, I recieved a call ..Meet them in the lobby. What?? I wasn't prepared for that. Just last night the driver came to my room..What changed over night?
It has a friendly staff and real reasonable prices!!!
DO NOT ORDER FOR DELIVERY. They do not bring you your order and try to tell you that what they brought you is what you ordered… 🤬🤬🤬
Have been ordering from here for about 5 years. We have tried many Chinese restaurants in the area but we always come back here. We have never been disappointed in the food or service.

The people here are nice so this is a suggestion rather than a complaint. Please cook your stir fry veggies a little longer. I love a nice crisp sauteed veggie but these still taste raw and squeaky on my teeth. Specifically the green pepper and celery. The steamed rice is a little hard today, too. Skim the fat off your sauces too, very greasy. And the tea has a slight dirty water after taste and got dammit my fortune cookie is stale smh....this turned into a complaint. sorry. do better yall.

I love their dumplings and Singapore Mei Fun (pancit). The lady is always very nice to me and it's cool that it's a family run business. Their wonton soup has subtle flavors and the hot and sour has more bold notes. The tea is hit or miss, but I've never had a problem getting hot food or waiting too long, but in always do carry out.
It's my go to place for Chinese take out. Nothing fancy, but it's always hot, tasty, and cheap

So, I ordered food at 9:06 and was told it would take an hour. Ok, no problem. When it became 10:30, I called for an ETA and was told the delivery guy was on his way. Then, another 25 minutes go by with still no food. What time did my food show up? 11:16. Oh, but they gave me a free bottle of coke to make up for the time I waited.  This is absolutely ridiculous and will N E V E R order from this place again.
Standard chinese carryout. Inexpensive. Sweet lunch special menu and an "open to close" combo menu.
The Food was awesome
If you're interested in eating within 2 hours of ordering, don't order from here.
Even tho I stop eating Chinese, this food here is still good.
Great food and God bless them..
Closes at 10pm but they take there phone off the hook at 9:30pm so they can't take anymore orders. Disappointed.
Great food
Closes at 10pm but they take there phone off the hook at 9:30pm so they can't take anymore orders. Disappointed.

Why. The service HORRIBLE! The undertone was a tad bit creepy... after waiting over 15-20 minutes for a waiter to take a drink order... (busy  - not at all)... didn’t get farther than that prior to my departure. Unacceptable!  My hard earned money goes to where the respect and service is given.  Know better to DO better. But I will never come back to this location. A disgrace.

Sampler appetizer was very good. My crabs were seasoned but it had absolutely no flavor. I really should have sent it back but in this climate I just didn't wanna seem like the angry black lady. Such a waste of money. Now I see why Olive garden next door had a long line and you could walk right in here. 🙄I won't be going back.

They just reopened recently so the one lost star is due to limited wait staff.  It looked too us like there was only 2 waitresses and one doubled as bartender.  Our food was amazing! We had crab cakes and the shrimp and fish platter, calamari,  and calamari chowder. All were great. Our waitress was friendly and did a good job keeping up with our drinks.  Will definitely be back.

The food was horrible.  You can tell they are really struggling and cutting food quality and costs to the bone.  Instead of melted butter they give you some oily water.  I drank a bit of this oily water to see if it tasted like anything; it tasted like water, not even salty.  The poor crabs must have been bargain-cheap last week's leftovers, the shells were more than half empty.  Really just a waste of time and money opening mostly empty shells.  I left hungry having eaten mostly corn and potatoes.

Service was excellent, Food was great.
Took my oldest son there for his Birthday, it was fantastic.
Great place to go and relax and enjoy good food
The food is excellent. Good choices to choose from and hard to decide
The Salmon was "AWESOME " and the "BEST " I have had in years.  I will be back for more.
The prices have gone up a lot. Was going to get the crab bucket for my birthday,  but too expensive.  Got swordfish and it was on the cold side, but had good flavor. Good server.
Service was great. Drink was good. Food was just average.

My wife and I just finished an early dinner...great choice. Our appetizer and meals were excellent; our server, Ava, was fantastic! I recommend that you ask to be seated in her area. Shrimp and mahi were fresh, and the crab/shrimp dip was scratch made and very tasty! You won’t regret a visit to this Joe’s..
Food was very good. I got the bite size shimp dinner which was a generous portion. Our waitress Kasey was awesome.
The staff here is incredible.  Friendly, helpful, and there when you need them, not when you don't.  Typical Joe's experience as far as food.

The establishment was not very busy, and the tables were well spaced. I noted two servers and one behind the bar. Service was good until our food came. We realized ordering the crab legs a la carte would have been cheaper. My drink was already empty before I began eating and my husband's emptied shortly after. We noted two of the three servers pass the table multiple times, and even look at the table. No one stopped to refill the drinks or long enough to be flagged down. Finally the manager stopped by and asked how our meal was and I had to ask for refills and noted that the glasses had been empty for awhile. No apologies were offered and we never saw who I assumed was our server until they brought the check. The food was subpar for the cost as well.
Pricey but delicious.. Amazing for our date night.. you guys rock and we'll be coming back to see you all..
It was good but it was so much better in the past.
Good service food was also good and hot also a play area outside for kids
We had an outstanding time with great service, fabulous food all in a fun environment.

While we were there socially distant seating existed and we felt safe.  I am so happy they are still in operation since some other JCSs in our area have closed in Fairfax.  We were very appreciative of all the attention they gave us.

Good to see them open again, but still pretty expensive for okay seafood. Good oyster deal if they have them. Excellent service! Dont expect to get a branded shaker with the marg deal they have on the menu but you may end up with an extra drink on the house.
Definitely not what I expected no season and very undercooked
The food and service was great. The price was a little high but other than that I really enjoyed my experience.
Excellent service and food was out right away. Nicole was very attentive to our party of 5.
Good food abit over priced but we love seafood
Waiter very unknowledgeable. food mediocre.menu not what we expected.

This is the second time my wife and I have gone to this restaurant. Just so you know I do not eat any type of seafood, fish, or clams nothing! I do not like the smell or taste, so the first time we went there I told my wife if the smell is to strong I will go to another restaurant near by and eat there (we went there for a friends birthday party and they did not know about me and fish). But it has no strong smell like at a fish market and I have been to ones in Seattle, Washington and Bergen, Norway. So both times I have eaten a cheeseburger which I think is very good, my wife had a fish taco and some of our friends had crabs and clams and they said it was good (the reason why we were eating here in the first place and same birthday party gang). This is a very casual dress place and the decorations and stuff hanging on the walls is like being at a sports bar / bait shop with all of the photos hanging up and of course large fiberglass sea creatures like a Great White Shark (about 8-10 feet long) a Leather-back Sea Turtle and other items.
A great family friendly location.
The fried food was decent, the grilled food was overcooked, prices were mildly high for what you get.
Great customer service by my waitress and the attendance who worked the door. Me n my coworker arrived at about 8:30-9:00pm

We made a random exit to check out something to eat for dinner. We chose this Joe’s Crab Shack. This is my first time to eat at a seafood restaurant and I wasn't disappointed. We ordered Ragin' Cajun
Pacific dungeness crab, queen crab, shrimp and smoked sausage. One word, delicious. The staff is great. The ambiance is good. Clean and unique restroom.

Got the chicken tacos (I know, chicken in a fish place) and they were delicious but half an hour later my stomach hurt so bad it took two doses of Alka Seltzer to get to the point where I could go to sleep. This was my first time there and sadly, it's my last. Unfortunate since the food was delicious but cross-contamination can ruin people's nights.
The staff here is incredible.  Friendly, helpful, and there when you need them, not when you don't.  Typical Joe's experience as far as food.
Great calamari, blue motorcycle, coconut shrimp with pineapple plum sauce and front manager..he handled customer service issue  excellently..♡
A great family friendly location.
Great but expensive
Had a great meal with family, the staff was great, meal was good.
So glad they are open and serving. Seafood is very good and nice to have nearby.
Wonderful restaurant food and service

Although our server was very late in approaching out table (almost half an hour) about a third of our orders wrong or missing items, she was still up beat and charming! We truly appreciated her efforts. The food however was was unforgivably flavorless! The menu mentioned that The Steamer option had garlic but there was no trace of garlic flavor on it. It was so disappointing! The calamari was over fried and too crispy and again flavorless. It's like they just steamed and fried frozen food straight out of a Sysco truck. Their garlic bread, which was also forgotten by our server, was stale and tasted like a yesterday's bread. Definitely never visiting a Joe's Crab shack ever again. Since we live close enough to Maryland we'd rather go to a proper seafood restaurant than this place, which is sad because we live close to this franchise.

Food was good when it finally came to table had to ask several times where it was. Took forever for the drink at the bar had to ask where that was. The one  manger is always nice and friendly he walked around checking on everyone. Nice for large parties,  will return.
Delicious but very over priced

Really nice place for lunch and dinner.  Although we missed the lunch specials the happy hour specials start immediately following the lunch specials.  Food and drink selection on happy hour is very good.  Staff and management are very friendly and visible.
Thank God it reopened love this place

Visited here Saturday 3/7/20 around 12:30p after we left Fun Land around the corner. Food was much better and hot since the last time we visited about 2 months ago. Ordered the Joe’s Classic for two Steampots (which me and mom shared and it was more than enough) -my favorite in the steampot were the sausages and the potatoes. Seasoned well and potatoes steamed just right. I also ordered a special they had which was the fish and chips for $8 . And that was so cooked perfectly with tartar sauce on the side. My kid had fries which were hot and good surprisingly.

Note to staff: Our waitress was very accommodating and nice. Very attentive and personable.  And also I don’t know what you all did since my last visit but keep it up. We spent over $150 last time we visited but our food was cold and not anything to write home about. But this visit everything was great ! No complaints. Seems like the kitchen paid more attention to detail and making sure food was edible.
really enjoyed it ...food was amazing
Over 1 HR wait that was extended without contact or information.  We didn't stay.

I love seafood, so....this is the closest one to me and at two hours away...the restaurant has always been clean fast and friendly. The associates always willing to help-without the eye roll! Just ate lunch. Food presented well, good portion size, way better than McDonald's. And they have great gear!!
Had a great meal with family, the staff was great, meal was good.
Great calamari, blue motorcycle, coconut shrimp with pineapple plum sauce and front manager..he handled customer service issue  excellently..♡
Food was awesome!
The food was Delicious
Good atmosphere

I got the Joe's classic usually it's good everything is cooked. Not this time the potatoes were hard and the sausage wasn't thoroughly cooked. The shrimp was still white..I will be going back n April I hope it will be better.
Had a good time at this place I enjoy Joe's Crab Shack to the utmost the waitresses and waiters were gracious and kind and enjoy this place a lot

FOOD WAS AWFUL! 🤢🤢Crab legs were small and overcooked. The potatoes were undercooked. I asked for extra shrimp and I got 6 very small shrimp.The only thing that I did like was the corn on the cob and my bf liked his sausage. The food wasn't like this a few yrs back but I will not be returning. The only reason for the 1 star was for the guy who took out to go order!
Good food excellent service!
Great food. Service was a little slow at first. I think we hit shift change but once our order was taken the food and service was excellent.
Great food just a little pricey for what you get.
Y’all need to update your online menu to your COVID menu you have in the restaurant very disappointed 😢
Good food

Crab legs ➡️Bland and watery... corn tasted like basement dirt..
Service was good and friendly..
great atmosphere.
When you spend that much money on a meal.. you should enjoy it...

Great seafood! Seems certain times are bad-sometimes very bad.  I think we have been lucky, cause we have NEVER had a bad meal!
Keep improving the help and all the problems will likely go away.
Great fast service. Our server Coleman was super cool and made sure we had everything we needed. His trainee also would stop by and make sure that our drinks were full.
Good food

Great seafood! Seems certain times are bad-sometimes very bad.  I think we have been lucky, cause we have NEVER had a bad meal!
Keep improving the help and all the problems will likely go away.

The service was great but the food was cold and not at all what I expected and for the price I expected a bit more and for the food to be at the least warm after all who wants to eat cold snow crabs. On the plus side of things we did get these cool little things to cut the crabs open and me and my family did buy a few of the cool shirts they have for sale.
Was pretty cool. I can see this being a popular place during the summer. Food is average.
The waiter was very nice but the quality of food was really bad. We got 2 crab buckets and they smelled old and they were slimy in the inside. Came out of there feeling very nasty
Exquisite food
The fact that there is an outdoor play area for kids earns this 5 stars.  Being able to have lunch while my daughter gets to play is priceless.  Especially not at a McDonalds
The waitress we had here was amazing!! But the food is definitely not worth the price in taste. I do not recommend if you like good seafood
Very nice place. Their cocktails are delicious and you can take they give you a glass/cup to take home (new one, not the one you drink out of)
We had James as our server and he was so polite. He was even attentive when my daughter talked to him.
Waited over 10 minutes for a drink order or something and no one showed up at our table ever so we left

I had to ask the waitress twice " where is the crab pictured on the menu?" She replied that they didn't have that crab on the menu. The crab pictured was a blue crab indigenous to the Rappahannock and the Potomac river which are both close to Fredericksburg VA. I would suggest that Joe change the name to Snow Crab Shack or King Crab Shack because he has no Blue Crabs. After learning the sad truth I settled for a Snow Crab bucket with corn and potatoes which was good. Service was good. Bathrooms not well marked but clean and modern. Bar well stocked and a good happy hour that I missed.

The staff is really nice and the birthday celebration we witness was cute. The food is good, but not as tasty as we though it'd be. My girlfriend got the coconut shrimp, which was really good; I got the Joe's classical, which had seasoning sprinkled on top, but as far as the taste, it was very bland. The corn that came with the plate was not fresh.

This location was the first and last time I'd eaten at a Joe's Crab Shack. Maybe it was mostly a poor experience because my date itself was a bit awkward (we decided to bring our kids which made everything a little more complicated and hard to talk (I'm not a smart man)), but the server was also a little annoying and kept talking to us, and the food itself was hella pricey despite being slightly sub-par.

Do not recommend this spot, or probably any of the crab shacks that Joe owns.

It was good to know that Joes crab shack still exists 🙂.

The food was pretty nice, along with the service.  It wasn't busy for the time we came but definitely a nice restaurant.  I will be there again soon
My very first visit there today was AWESOME! The food & hospitality was very pleasant! I will definitely go back again. :)

Food wasn't cooked and bill wasn't adjusted after manager agreed to take the entree off my bill. Was in such a rush I paid the whole bill and even left the waiter a %20 tip because he was attentative. Still not too thrilled with my eating experience.
Great place for a variety of seafood. They also have happy hour specials at the bar. Great place to bring kids. Outdoor seating is available during warmer seasons. They sell tshirts too.
Food is great nice variety of seafood, sandwiches and salads etc. Service was friendly and fast.
This is my number one place- my main man!! Love you love you love.. I will see you soon.

I would have loved to give this establishment 5 stars. Our waitress was a young Caucasian female who was expecting (pregnant) looked as though she was due at any given moment. Her customer service was phenomenal. She was amazing.

She did not look tired, stressed nor out of sync. She Checked on our table regularly, refilled drinks often and even asked several times if we needed anything. She definitely deserved the $20 tip that I gave to her. I ordered the raging Cajun snow crab pot and my snow crab legs were super small.

I mean for the price that I paid I could have went to giant seafood section. Super disappointed. I figured driving over a hour and a half away from home for seafood would have been a great idea but oh boy was I so wrong...
Good food, good service.. pricey but worth it
New and better menu items. Fast and courteous service with reasonable prices. We plan to return.

Wow this is the BEST Joe's crab shack that we have ever been to. The staff is friendly and helpful. Even the managers and general manager stopped by to make sure they were providing great food and service.  The  Bourbon shrimp appetizer was fantastic. Along with a couple of pieces of garlic bread that made sopping up the sauce even more delectable. We also had the East Coast platter. This had to nice pieces of fish-and-chips with it as well as some shrimp wrapped in bacon And some great clam strips and a wonderful crab cake. We would highly recommend you enjoying a meal here.
Love sea food! The Pena Coladas were the best. The birthday dinner for my friend was  successful, Thanks
Not the same. Used to be fun and friendly atmosphere. Told waitress one person had nut allergy. She responded that they had a gluten free menu. Had to ask for manager. Food was sub par.
I had a very good experience my food was good & excellent service.
Joe's Classic Steamer Pot for two... A good meal for three if you add 1/2 pound of shrimp. Good service, and management stopped by multiple times to check up on us.
We haven't been here for a long time! Hubby treated us to the Valentine's Day seafood boil! Delicious!😋😋😋
Great customer service. Amazing food. Never had a bad experience here
Friendly staff, great service and awesome food. Shout out to Taylor for being an awesome waitress today and even gave me a to go cup for my soda without me asking. Can't recommend enough!
disgusting on all levels. soggy fried fish and bland sides. fresh seafood smells like seafood, but doesnt stink. this place left a horrible smell on my clothes. like old bay and dumpster.

Omg this one the first time I have ever been to Joe’s Crab Shack ! My girlfriend who took me out there ! it was her second time at one in Greenville SC ..Our first time together in lovely Fredericksburg Virginia! We had so much fun thanks to our awesomeness server named Joshua ! We definitely hope that we get him again ! He made us feel so special! And he had us laughing and smiling the whole time! Omg we needed this ! And was so attentive us .. He made our first time there very happy and we will definitely be back again ! We have just relocated to the area and so excited! This is our first restaurant in the area to visit! The food was so delicious and prices are very reasonable and lots of great things on the menu to choose from! We ordered two steam pots of seafood omg so good ! We highly recommend this location! All the staff are so sweet and friendly! Has a very cozy vibe too ! Thanks so much guys for making our weekend so sweet ! See y’all soon!!
The food is good. Service was good. The restaurant is clean. Desert is delicious!
Josh made our first visit lovingly memorable #lovedit
Super busy on Valentine's but the staff was very friendly and food was awesome!

Good experience for the most part. Our food took a long while to arrive considering there were few customers there at the time. The food itself was delicious with nice portions.  I would recommend this place.
Usually get served terrible seafood here. Also one of the waiters spilled tea all overly Mom one day because, as he put it, "Didn't like her." No other explanation was given.

Happy hour has great specials the food was amazing and our Bartender, well she was amazing a bright friendly smile and she provided the best service we've had in such a long time. We'll definitely be back to Joe's soon.
We were so excited to see this one still open. They were so good! Nice to see nothing has changed, same good service and food!
What great little spot...first visit but not the last
Good food and service for decent prices.  I would bring my family.

Overall fair dining experience. Waiter must have been new because he had trouble knowing w oi at certain items were. Had no idea what a craft and/or an IPA beer were even though the menu stated..."ask our staff about local brews...". Had trouble with knowing what was available food wise as well. Once everything got ironed out...which took way too much time...the food got to the table. Not sure if I'll go back.
Pricey, but good food, fast service and a playground for kids.

IF you understand this is a laid back seafood restaurant, part of the Landry, empire of various restaurants and casinos, you will be happy you came here. Great for kids or a cold beer or eating seafood without silverware. You can take your mother in law to the small gift shop, not Crackle Barrel. Sign up for Joe's emails a week before you visit to receive a free appetizer.
The service is great, the food the good, the prices for the crab legs is a little too high.
Great staff and yummy food! I was happy to see there was a Crab Shack when we moved here and I'm happy!
Awesome service! Fast and hot! Best crabcake sandwich I've had in a while. All lump, very little breading.

Frozen seafood steamed into an over-seasoned rubber.

The food has always been dissapointing, but for some reason people keep planning things there.

Service is hit or miss.

The sweet tea is delicious.
Great meal and service $$$

Excellent, great patient service, food great & manager visited our table.  I believe shows there commitment to service. Surprised at level of quality coming from a chain.Love the casual atmosphere so many decent seafood restaurants try to make there places upper end on price & atmosphere. Seafood should be comfortable
Great fast service. Our server Coleman was super cool and made sure we had everything we needed. His trainee also would stop by and make sure that our drinks were full.
The food and service was great! A shoutout to our server Annie. Great job!
Lovely, and waitress was a delight!  Kind of new white girl with long blond hair.  Came from Logans!
The food was ok staff was cool the manager was not to friendly but its room for growth

Friendly restaurant with plenty of food options. I highly disliked the crab sandwich. It literally tasted like tuna fish, bread crumbs and Old Bay seasoning.  If you are going to have the words, "Crab Shack" in your name, at least have quality crab meat!
Always a crowd pleaser with those steam pots!
Quality makes the price worth eating here
Always a great time here. Awesome food and great employees.
Love their food (and their crab dip is to die for!) But if you're looking for FRESH crabs, they're not here....

I gave the restaurant 4 stars because the food was OK,  but not bad.  The service was very slow.  We almost walked out because it was 10 minutes from the time we were sat at the table, to the time the server came to our table for drinks.  I got the all you can eat shrimp, but I only want one type.  The first plate was a sampler plant, and I wasted most of that because I didn't care for the steamed shrimp.
Excellent food great happy hour at the bar. The ladies behind the bar were a delight.
Very friendly staff and the food was good too
It wasn't a very good place to celebrate my birthday. The Food was awful .The seafood was full of fake ingredients. The waitress were all nice, they sung Happy birthday to me.
Food was fast and hot. The waitress well friendly and polite. We came it when it was slow so I'm sure that helped as well. I enjoyed it and so did my company.
Good food but...  They kept trying to sell this awards program.  And it was just creepy.  It completely wrecked the meal.  Never going back.
Really good food. Excellent choices, friendly and responsive wait staff in homey, down to Earth crab shack atmosphere.

Crab was good, lobster not so much, prices were as high as any other seafood place in the area.  Would have given a 4 but the staff literally acted like we were a bother to them. 2 waitresses were jaw jacking at the hostess stand when we walked in, I smiled and said hello. They looked at me like a deer caught in headlights then seemed annoyed when she asked us how many. The place was practically empty yet they were scrambling to figure out where to seat us, mumbling amongst themselves.  Once seated, a young lady came over to get our drinks, another server came by and asked if our drink order was already taken we said yes and I asked if I could ask her a question, she said she wasn't sure if she was our server and walked away. When our server finally got to us, she did apologize for the wait. She seemed nice but, then disappeared. We got our food and about 3/4 way through I wanted to order more crab. We didn't even see her for 15 minutes and when we did she went out to the patio through one door and came back in through the front, bypassing us. I decided to forgo the extra order of crab and dessert for our son because we didn't have another hour to wait in an empty restaurant. We will not be back.
People were nice . Food was good just VERY HIGH .for what we had
Nicole was great and the food was very tasty. Loved it all!

I waited at front desk 5 minutes or more before being acknowledged. The hostesss knew little about nothing and wasn't motivated with my interest in the menu to get my questions answered. I settled on crabcake sandwich. Dollop of crab patty did not cover bun. Lettuce was shredded and the pitiful slice of tomatoe didn't cover the dollop of crab on the big fat perfect bun. Disappointing experience. I will not be going back.
Great customer service. My server was awesome with my children.

Haven't been a while but was pleasantly surprised.  It was early lunch time and so not terribly crowded at all. Our server Arian (sp?) Was super nice and went above and beyond. Drinks were really on point. The food was delicious and served up fast.  We had a great time and will return.

Seafood., crab cakes.   . Crab legs
.reasonably priced.
If you want something you could get in you're  local grocery stores  frozen food section this place is perfect
Great service while celebrating a 6 year old's birthday! Great atmosphere for adults and kids.
The server messed up my order and then tried to lie to me instead of just fixing the issue, but otherwise the food was great.
Good.. little pricey but Good
Great place, good food and nice customer service
Really good food meals are a little small prices are very inflated booze is  Overpriced
Excellent service for lunch! The seafood was cooked to perfection! Could it have been better, yes, but was still amazing.
Food was good, service was meh. Play area was convenient. At least the kids are occupied and entertained.
Delicious food, came quickly. The side salad was very fresh and crisp. I got blackened mahi and it was excellent. Friendly staff as well.
Our crab was over cooked, had to scrape it out of the shell. Store is dirty. Staff is slow.
Nice & professional wait staff. The manager made sure we were OK. The restaurant was clean. The bathrooms were clean. Good food.

I heard a lot of good things about this place so I wanted to check it out. It was not as crowded as I thought it would be. But be aware that parking can be difficult. I didn't see a parking lot here and I parked on the street. So I imagine if it gets busy it might be hard to find a spot. I ordered the Mac and cheese with pulled pork and my friend got a brisket sandwich. One of the main things that stood out to me here is everyone is so friendly! From the person greeting me when I walked in, the person taking my order, making my food, checking me out at the end, and even when I went to leave. They told me "we hope you had a great time and we hope you come back!". Everyone there made the experience great. The food was good and my friend said it was the best brisket she's had and that the espresso BBQ sauce was perfect. I can't even say that I have a complaint but I do have a suggestion. They have a lot of different bbq sauces from espresso BBQ, to vinegar, to a house made. I would just really like to see a sweeter sauce. I know living so close to Carolina I'm going to find a lot of vinegar style sauces. But I do enjoy a sweeter sauce. The house one is ok but for me it was still a little on the vinegar side. Either way I will definitely be back!

First time trying Redwood Smoke Shack. Food was flavorful and tender. We got the meat sweats platter which comes with 2 bones, pulled chicken, pulled pork, brisket, pickled onions, jalapenos, pickles, cornbread and 2 sides. We got mac n cheese and baked beans. The mac n cheese was average and the baked beans were delicious! The cornbread was how I like it moist with a hint of sweetness.  We also got burnt ends which was very good as well. You can make it into a platter,  but I choose not to because I wanted the corn and that wasn't offered as a side. The corn was amazing! They slather some creamy cilantro sauce on it after it's been roasted. I absolutely loved it. The customer service is awesome. Very friendly people. They have a sink next to the drink machine, which I loved because it's bbq, so of course your hands are going to get dirty. There is indoor and patio seating.  6 tables inside and 8 outside. The flies were a both at the outdoor tables but that's to be expected. They have rolls of paper towels at some of the tables and sauce trays. The sauces were okay. But I personally didn't need sauce on my meats because it was seasoned perfectly well. Next time I'm going to try the pulled chicken sammich with cole slaw.

I ordered again and platters were horrible. The ribs were not fresh and burnt. The Slaw wasn't like the first two times. Your platters are expensive so you should bring it in every time you sell them. I don't know if there are several different  people cooking and preparing your food but notice different taste in seasonings cooking. I was looking for consistency. I'm very disappointed for what I paid for.

(beans, collards and corn pudding) And our desserts were banana misu and bread pudding. Also washed it all down with some delicious sweet tea. We will definitely patronize that place again in the future.

First time trying Redwood Smoke Shack. Food was flavorful and tender. We got the meat sweats platter which comes with 2 bones, pulled chicken, pulled pork, brisket, pickled onions, jalapenos, pickles, cornbread and 2 sides. We got mac n cheese and baked beans. The mac n cheese was average and the baked beans were delicious! The cornbread was how I like it moist with a hint of sweetness.  We also got burnt ends which was very good as well. You can make it into a platter,  but I choose not to because I wanted the corn and that wasn't offered as a side. The corn was amazing! They slather some creamy cilantro sauce on it after it's been roasted. I absolutely loved it. The customer service is awesome. Very friendly people. They have a sink next to the drink machine, which I loved because it's bbq, so of course your hands are going to get dirty. There is indoor and patio seating.  6 tables inside and 8 outside. The flies were a both at the outdoor tables but that's to be expected. They have rolls of paper towels at some of the tables and sauce trays. The sauces were okay. But I personally didn't need sauce on my meats because it was seasoned perfectly well. Next time I'm going to try the pulled chicken sammich with cole slaw.
Pulled pork was tender and tasty, the cilantro slaw was fantastic and the beans were savory. Highly recommend for great BBQ.
Decent BBQ but it is quite bland. Had to use my own spices at home to make it good.
Food was OK but the price of the food is a joke 3 pcs of beef brisket and 4 bones of ribs and some fries for 42 dollars Are you serious

Your platters are expensive so you should bring it in every time you sell them. I don't know if there are several different  people cooking and preparing your food but notice different taste in seasonings cooking. I was looking for consistency. I'm very disappointed for what I paid for.

Call before you go! The fact that they run out of food on a daily basis is a testament to the satisfaction of their clients. They take great pride in the smoking of their foods and offer the traditional items you'd find in most quality family backyard barbecues! It ain't cheap! My wife and I sat down for a piece of brisket, an order of burnt ends, two ribs, two sides, a beer and a Coke and the bill before tip was almost $60. There's only a few seats inside and their covered back porch can seat slightly more than 20 people in four table settings. On good weather days, they offer unprotected outside seating were you might find some local quality entertainment. Like most good barbecue joints, they have a variety of sauces offered. I particularly liked the espresso. They have a nice dry rub that appears to be a simple salt and mostly pepper seasoning that allows you to eat the meat without the sauce if you choose. It's a great family setting and you can expect to find everything from younger adults to families with younger children enjoying the surroundings and a simple meal prepared the right way.

Redwood Smoke Shack won Veer Magazine Best Food Truck in 2017 and 2018. Bob and the crew are down to Earth, eager to please, and customer service oriented. His Texas inspired BBQ is smack your Mom good, and my Mom agrees! All the sauces are scratch made, of which I highly recommend the espresso BBQ. It's like if Seattle's best and Franklin's got real drunk one night. Everything on the menu is delicious, but far and above all offerings are the burnt ends. They're just little chunks of meat candy cascading down from smoker heaven. Bob frequently makes one off specials, the most popular being the pork belly burnt ends or the brontosaurus ribs. The best menu item to cut your teeth on Bob's carnivorous genius is The Woody - several of his smoked meats, the cilantro lime slaw, and sauces on a Krispy Kreme donut. Sweet and savory!!! I really love it when he posts up outside of MoMac Brewery. Beer and BBQ go together like Forrest and Jenny . . . minus all the rampant drugs and whatnot. Buy some Redwood SWAG and get the discount! #MeatManCometh #RedwoodDisciple

This is my first review in forever and I'm here because YOU need to be here. I've been wanting to try auntie's for a few weeks but between mixed reviews and an obsession with the sub shop across the street..well, anyway. The sub shop is closed for labor day weekend...to aunties we went. As other reviews noted, the hostess was so sweet and very chill. I'm not sure if it was Heidi Joy, but she was nice as pie. We chose to sit outside as it was an absolutely beautiful night, we weren't bothered by any flies or anything. I loved all the plants outside, but I also wanted to give them some love (call me!)
I ordered a Ting to drink as I don't drink alcohol, it's a great option to have and I hope they keep it. We started with pork lumpia, obviously, but next time we'll try the spam. It was lumpia, and as always lumpia is delicious. Served with a side of sweet chili sauce and some sort of vinegar, you can't beat lumpia and a sunset. I was brave enough to try the vinegar and I totally get it.
This is getting lengthy but I've been thinking about this dinner for hours guys...
It took some time for our food to come out, but we don't lean towards the impatient side usually and it was totally fine. Just maybe don't go if you're in a hurry! We ordered the chicken adobo and aunties double cheese burger which is actually a beef patty AND longanisa which is a delicious Filipino sausage. You guys..this was literally the best burger I have EVER had. It was juicy, perfectly cooked (she didn't ask how i wanted it cooked and i didn't tell her) it came out medium well but still amazing somehow?? And it was topped with BANANA KETCHUP MAYO oh man. You can't make this stuff up. I had a bite of the chicken adobo and the chicken was sooo flavorful and tender, without any sauce! The sauce was just a bonus. I believe they used a jasmine rice which I loved.
Between the 2 of us it was about $40 and we don't usually spring for an appetizer. Next time I'm trying to calamansi pie!!!
Thank you Auntie's, I love you.

Edited to add: I ordered the mac salad side and I ended up not liking it much at all. Just not my thing, other friends love that stuff! When the server came out to check on us I told her how much I loved the burger and said "I can't say the same about the mac but that's okay cause the burger makes up for it" she asked if I wanted a replacement and I kind of did but I hate to be that person "I dont want yall to have to do that..but i do love fries"
She was more than happy to get me some and let me tell ya they were equally amazing. I told her it was like they soaked up all the flavors in that kitchen, I really don't know how these fries "tasted Filipino" but they did.

Edit 2 its the next morning and I'm having my leftovers for breakfast. Honestly I can die happy

Fan-frickin-tastic! Why have I not been here before the past week?! I'll tell you why, because I've been a loyalist to Bale Family Bakery and Pho Sate in Falls Church. I just always went with what I knew, and never looked back.

What a disservice I did to myself. To have this gem, less that half a mile from the house is a game changer.

Very easy and relatable menu, nothing too crazy, but a great variety and good for those looking to delve in Vietnamese cuisine, without going overboard.

Pho is solid. Fantastic broth. Limited choice of selections, yet still ticks all the boxes.

Great shaky beef.great spring and summer rolls.

Dumplings are awesome, super filling and thin skinned.

Shrimp toast is awesome.

The grilled pork is worth the price of admission alone.

Looking forward to workingt5througj more of the menu, especially the bun bo hue.

The shrimp crackers and complimentary creme caramel/flan are a really nice touch.

Service is good, not hovering, yet attentive.

Reasonably priced.

Do it if you haven't already. You won't regret it. Support you local!

This was one of the most authentic, flavorful and delicious Vietnamese restaurants that we’ve ever been to. Totally a hidden gem in Fairfax.

They gave out shrimp chips as an appetizer. We both had the lunch specials with the garden rolls, which were excellent. Peanut sauce was good. The vermicelli bowl was, quote from my better half, “the best I’ve ever had.”
The pho broth was clean and perfectly refreshing even on a summer day. They gave us complementary caramel flan for dessert - perfect size. I also had a Vietnamese iced coffee, which was really good.

Customer service was amazing. Definitely coming back here again. We’ve been to a lot of Vietnamese restaurants in VA but this one has made it to the top of our list!
The soup base is very flavorful, the meat and meatballs were fresh in the pho. A lot of care goes into their food and the flan was delicious.

They gave us flan on the house, it was really sweet of them. The tofu pho and lemongrass pho were okayish. Overall a decent place to dine in.

Cloudy with a Chance of Pho

East Wind offered me a delicious reprieve from the cold, rainy day. The expansive menu offers authentic cuisine while managing to add their own personality and flair. The egg noodle pho is personally the best I've ever had; and I just got back from Hanoi. Quail and dumplings in the broth may not be the most traditional but all Vietnamese restaurants must take note. It's a nearly perfect Asian fusion.

The atmosphere may be sparse on the inside with wide berths between tables (such a contrast from Vietnam) but the few pleasantries do add a touch of character.

Those wishing to satisfy any craving for real-deal Vietnamese cuisine - spring rolls, bun cha, and the pho, let the wind whisk you to downtown Fairfax for a delicious (ngon) dine.

We love to come here to eat before going to the Cinema Arts Theatre.  Everything is delicious!

My favorite restaurant in Fairfax! We come here at least once a week. Everything is so delicious you really can't go wrong. For appetizers, our favorites are the EastWind Shrimp special and the rare beef carpaccio. For entrees, we usually rotate around between the crispy shrimp and squid, the beef wrapped in grape leaves, and the spicy beef hue soup! The pho here is amazing too though! The desserts are always delicious too... the caramel flan always has the perfect texture, the mango sticky rice is so unexpectedly enjoyable, and the fried bananas and ice cream is awesome too. Service is always super friendly and attentive.

I would upload more photos... but I'm usually so excited about the food I dig in and clean the plate before I remember to take my phone out. It's THAT GOOD.

The dry version is not on the menu, but since it is a common dish the waiter said he will ask the kitchen to prepare it so. I kept my fingers crossed since most places make the dish bland, for they only prepared it as soup dish or didn't make the proper sauce to eat with it.  Eastwind did it right! I was please. The taste is still not full flavor as some places, but it is also fresh and well balanced.  They brought out fried cake (bánh phồng tôm) as appetizer for free! This is akin to breads in steakhouse. Pleasant surprise there. 4 stars because I don't know how the other menu items tasted, but if this dish is any indication, they most likely as good and authentic. I'm keep the last star for final judgement. Oh also the staff is a bit aloof. I guessed they were trained not to interrupt your meals as other places often do.

When you walk in the front door it hits like home...well if home is an incredibly designed space. Color, texture  and ambiance! Service is efficient, proficient and unobtrusive. Cameron did a great job!!

There are few places I would drive an hour and a half to enjoy, Moonshadows is one !!!!

Service was full of good intentions but it was a long wait for water, another long wait for a glass of wine, despite very few patrons. Food was tasty but smaller portions for a considerable price. Probably not going to return.

The kitchen and wait staff knocked this one out of the park. It's also a wonderful little place with great decor. We'll definitely go back!

The entirety of our visit was awesome. The choice of table location, to the food, and service - all was spot on! Essence was a great server too. The food portions were perfect, well prepared, delicious, and we ate every morsel! We'd certainly return when in the area.

If you are looking for a glass of wine and good atmosphere it’s a lovely place. Food is very overpriced. Costs 9$ to add 4 pieces of medium shrimp to a very small salad. Also they were out of a lot of things. The crab rolls were okay but they ran out of crab and used what seemed like one piece of medium shrimp cut up between 4 rolls and the rest was lettuce. We were seated first but other tables were served first.

In February 2020, I visited this cute place while visiting Luray for my birthday. The experience I had here was exactly what I was hoping for, a humble southern meal and hospitable staff, in a comfortable relaxed environment. Very happy with the decision to eat here, it added to my great birthday in Luray!

Moonshadows is a wonderful local restaurant in Luray. The staff was knowledgeable and welcoming. The restaurant boasts a delicious seasonal menu with fresh, quality ingredients. We enjoyed the BBQ shrimp and cheddar grits, the lamb pita, baklava, and Moonshadows Pie (a gingerbread and lemon treat). All of it was absolutely delicious. The cheddar grits and shrimp were among the best I’ve ever had! The Moonshadows Pie was amazing - combining gingerbread and lemon (two of my favorite flavors) in such an unexpectedly delightful way. We can’t wait to come back in the summer to enjoy a whole new menu!
Vegan options at this thoughtful restaurant.  Reasonable prices and great service.
Good food and good service. Nice place for dinner for Date night.

Great environment to have dinner. Good wine and beer list. The beer could have been a bit colder. The artichoke parsnip dip was not good at all. Tasted a bit like baby food. Even though there are fewer customers, the service is lacking and the food was not cooked to order. Their signature dessert the moonpie cake is just ok. It's texture is coarse and it lacks any defining character. It's ok.

From there on, service was good and the food is outstanding!

First off, best Indian food and one of the best restaurants overall in the area.

Finally, perhaps most impressively, the people here care and are attentive.  We ordered two dishes and made sure there was no dairy. The buffet isn't huge, but I felt like there was plenty to chose from - especially for the very reasonable price of $7.95. They offered two kinds of basmati rice, chicken curry, roasted tandoori chicken with peppers & onions, tandoori chicken with a creamy tomato sauce, korma curry, and a variety of vegetables that were prepared in different ways. There was a small salad bar, which also had fruit, chocolate mousse, & rice pudding. AND - they bring you a basket of garlic naan! I was a huge fan of the curry and the two tandoori dishes. The garlic naan was delicious as well - and I particularly liked it with the tzatziki-like sauce (which was much better than the ranch dressing I accidentally got). I wasn't too fond of some of the vegetables (particularly the fried broccoli) or the rice pudding, but the chocolate mousse and orange slices served as a nice ending.

The service was very good and the atmosphere is cool. It's not the tacky Bollywood look that some Indian places have and there is plenty of space to handle busy crowds. My daughter-in-law and I had lunch here the other day while we were getting our windshield replaced.  It was our first visit, but will not likely be our last.

The food was exquisite.  Everything we ordered was freshly prepared, and cooked to perfection.  The service was nothing short of amazing, even with a brand new server; this place knows the value of teamwork.

I ordered the hamburger steak with onions and gravy, medium, with potato salad and steamed broccoli.  The meat was sweet and tender and cooked exactly as I asked.  The broccoli melted in my mouth, and the potato salad was perfect (definitely "home cooked").

She ordered the Delmonico, medium rare, with hush puppies and steamed broccoli.  Same as my food... everything cooked exactly as requested... perfection.

We both had sweet tea to drink.  If you are looking for real southern sweet tea, then this is where you will find it.  It has been a very long time since we have found this, properly made, in any restaurant.

For dessert, I had the banana pudding, and she had the Boston Cream Pie.  Again, obviously "home cooked" rather than store bought.

The atmosphere was about average for a family restaurant.  Keep in mind that this place is not new.

The only negative: They do NOT take plastic, so bring your cash and avoid the defective ATM inside the front door.

Today is our 2nd visit to Dok Khao within a month's time and it's officially and easily become one of my favorite places to eat. To start,  they are doing an amazing job with covid-19 protocol / guidelines. You can choose to go paperless menu by scanning a QR code on every table. Very elegant single-use utensils, disposable appetizer plates, and cups. Entrees come in carry-out containers. If you're a fan of the spice rack, as I am, they bring you a little of whichever you would like in tiny plastic condiment containers. As for the taste, I challenge anyone to find a restaurant with better tasting Thai cuisine in the area. It's to die for! And so far we have only had the friendliest and most attentive hosts/servers. They're great at their job and makes the experience even better. There is also a guy that came around, whom I'd like to assume may be the manager, during both visits to ask and make sure everything was to our liking. The Dok Khao Pad Thai, Pad Cellophane, and crispy salmon roll (appetizer) are my fave so far, but everything has been delicious. The drinks are heavenly. The Magic Margarita is my fave. They have so much food and drinks on their menu so there is still much more to try. Still haven't been able to save room for dessert. Both the Thai Iced tea and coffee are perfection. The prices here are as expected for amazingly great food, drinks, and service. Most definitely will be returning again soon!

I ordered this Philips 4K TV for my brother in law on Black Friday 2018 but did not receive it until the middle of December. There was a miscommunication with my brother in law so the driver, not understanding him, took the TV back to Richmond where it sat for weeks. I called BJ's, the carrier and NO ONE would help me get the TV delivered. No one would even tell me where it was! BJ's REFUSED to contact CEVA Logistics to get the TV delivered. I had to spend countless hours on the phone with the carrier and boy their hold times are measured in hours not minutes!! Finally CEVA Logistics gave me the number for Richmond (why couldn't this be done sooner?) and I was able to arrange delivery for late that week. After all this time my brother in law decided he did not want the TV and bought one from Walmart. I was stuck with the TV and decided I would keep it instead of returning it. I set it up and it worked for less than 15 minutes!!! I turned it on and after 10-15 minutes the picture began to fade from vibrant 4K to a dull unwatchable picture and would flicker from bright to dull. In the end I had to re-pack it and bring it to my local BJ's. In the short time I had it I did like the apps and the availability. But, navigating the TV was cumbersome. Nothing easy or intuitive. It was a pain to use, but had it worked I would have kept it. All in all a VERY nerve wracking experience with BJ's and their terrible customer service people. Delivery was a nightmare and even though I will NEVER order anything from BJ's online again: IF I were to I'd have the items shipped to the store because home delivery is not something you want to deal with.

On a Sunday morning (Nov 1) there were just two people working and only one of them was making drinks and taking orders (I couldn’t tell what the other person was doing). It was pouring rain so I tried to order ahead on the phone but the first call got disconnected after I was placed on hold and then every time I called back there wasn’t any answer. The recording suggested placing an order online so I went to their website and the immediate pickup option said it would be ready in 30-35 minutes (too slow). When I showed up the person making drinks had to walk around the counter to get to the front window to take orders and collect payment. The people in front of me waited at the window for their order to be ready. When they were done and left, I stepped forward to place my order & pay and then stepped back to allow the person behind me to place an order (thinking this was more efficient). That person had a pickup order that did not appear to be ready yet so they made his order and then made mine after. I tried to order a soy iced latte and they did not have soy milk which was a bit surprising for a coffee shop. The straws are paper and turn to mush unless you chug your drink. The coffee itself was good, but the ordering process and staffing could use some improvement. I’d suggest biodegradable straws that aren’t made of paper or sippable lids like they have at Starbucks to avoid the straws altogether.

From a business perspective, I see the merits of full service to increase the avg ticket price, and discourage individuals from using the location as their personal offices, but it's a coffee bar! They should be encouraging people to visit and be happy that they are there, even if they aren't buying a full meal. That just means more repeat business and better word of mouth.
