Beautiful birthday cakes baked with love. Colorfully designed cookies. Pretzels both savory and sweet. Delicious German sausages and German delicatessen foods galore. Yes! They make sandwiches too!

Charming area to dine inside. Cute area outside with shade trees and tables topped with umbrellas.

There's also a small market with gourmet German foods, herbs and spices for bread dipping, birthday cards, candles, colorful paper napkins and plates.

While waiting to check out there were German folks in line ahead of me complimenting the staff on their cookies, cakes and sandwiches. Remarking that they "always come here" for the best European baked goods and authentic German-style sandwiches.

And the staff are so nice! Actual smiles and sincere thank yous.

This place is a true treasure. Please support this locally owned family business. You will not be disappointed.

Excellent brats and hot German potato salad outside. Delicious pastries inside...almond sweet pretzels, cherry strudel, lemon poppy pound cake, pretzels and more. Also Kuhne sweet Bavarian style mustard and traditional German mustard! Shopped inside first and then bought our grilled lunch to go! ♡♡♡

Even tho I drive almost 30 mi to the Heielberg bakery, it is especially worth the trip!
The cakes are scrumptious, pastries are outstanding & the sandwiches are to die for.
Happy customer.  😄👍

One of our favorite bakeries in all of DC! Going to Heidelberg is an experience. On weekends (pre-Covid), there will sometimes be live music inside. The selection of baked goods is INCREDIBLE and you will have a hard time choosing! We have tried breads, donuts, muffins, danishes, croissants, and more - everything is always amazing! Staff is SO friendly and fun, very attentive and quick service, too! If you haven't already visited Heidelberg, I highly recommend it!!!

Loved this place. Everything is baked fresh and in house. Prices are reasonable and they have a wide variety. My friends German and she said this is as authentic as it gets. I tried the bread and pretzel and they were both delicious

Ordered 4 King Cakes for fat Tuesday for our Retiment community mardi gras celebration. By the time I arrived at the celebration, the king cakes had been devoured and they were all anyone could talk about. Thank you for helping to create a sweet spot for our seniors!
Delicious and way too many yummy choices!

Amazing selection of European baked goods. Also great bratwurst, plus brauenwurst and knackwurst. They had a special selection of Irish items the weekend of St. Patrick’s day. Plus they give out samples on Saturdays! Not a lot of table space to sit and enjoy a pastry and a coffee, but it depends on whether you’re coming at peak times. Everything is reasonably priced too. $6.95 for a whole Irish soda bread. $6 for a bratwurst. $18.95 for a giant rainbow cake. Totally worth it.

Been coming here since I was a little kid, so about 30 years now. Absolutely, hands down the best bakery in the area. Everything from delicious homemade bread to pastries and donuts to some deli meats and fixins, this place has it all. Can’t believe it’s taken me this long to give them their 5 stars
An amazing German bakery and deli with a high assortment of pastries, cookies, and breads. Many items are as affordable as a grocery store, but far better. The whole grain rye bread is awesome

I was very pleased that my order, phoned in earlier in the week, was carefully boxed up and waiting for me.  Despite being very busy, everyone I had contact with was cheerful and helpful.  Of course, the pastries are top notch, as I have come to expect over my over 40 years of patronage.
They really hit it out with their pies.  Ask the staff what their favorite picks are as some of the off the beaten track stuff is the best.

The pastries are delicious.
And the Sándwiches omg....😋😋
Amazingly good
Wonderful pastries and breads. Don't pass up a breakfast sandwich or the sausage cart (when it's in season).

Pastries by Randolph....closed today so we went to Heidelberg it was awesome! Well be going back again and again.
They have marzipan stollen!
Great place, very friendly and found a lot of stuff that reminds me of home
Worth a visit for some pastries.   My favorite is the Pig Ears, which they tend to sell out quickly.
This place feels like a legitimate old world bakery. The pretzels are very distinct and what I haven't tried there looks very delicious. They also sell a 2 lb pretzel!

Stopped by with my daughter to pick up some treats.  She had a lot of fun looking at all of the baked goods.  We got some donuts, eclairs, cookies, and a cupcake.  Everything was delicious and the service was excellent - prompt and friendly.  I will be back!

There are tons of options here and they all look really scrumptious. We enjoyed all the pastries that we tried. The only cons is if you're a first time visitor (which I was), you wouldn't know that you have to take a number and the number machine thingy is not easily noticable. I waited for a few minutes then heard an employee calling out number, only then I realized that I need to go get a #. I had time to kill that morning so it wasn't a big deal, but for others, they might not be as cool about it.
But don't let that stop you from visiting this bakery. We really enjoyed it:)
One of the best bakeries in Arlington. The staff is always friendly. Lots of traditional items, my daughter really likes the chocolate, marzipan animals and I like the lemon poppy seed cake.

Great food. Not too much seating, but free samples as well. Most people seemed nice, but there person i had actually dropped my cake, and didn't even apologize, even though it was in a bag. Free water as well

An absolute gem and a source of endless joy! We're on a quest to try every different bread. For sweets our personal recommendation would be the Linzer schnitte. But you really can't go wrong no matter what.
Great place to pick up German foods such as bread, sausages, and pastry.  They also have some pantry items and treats.
Great shoppe! Everything looks delicious here!
A great treat for the Arlington neighborhood.
Bringing their apple pie to Thanksgiving dinner has become an annual tradition for us.  Be sure to buy an extra one for yourself or when you get it home it may not last until Thanksgiving.
My first time here and I'm very happy, this young workers are very friendly and professionals...food is really amazing! Come over for good German goodies🇩🇪🇩🇪
The staff are very attentive. They will even help you take out your order to your car if you can't carry it by yourself.
Best bread gor miles and miles. Prompt service foes not allow for enough time to view everything. Saturdsys they have a grill cart with some awsome sausages
Just a great bakery.

Best bakery/deli shop in Northern Virginia. Have been going here for years -great meat, cheese, bread, sweets (can't find beinstick anywhere else). When we were planning our wedding, we didn't consider any other bakery for our wedding cake. Loved how it turned out and receive compliments even after the wedding on how delicious it was!
Nice place prices are good not to expensive nice place to visit
I came Sunday morning. Price tag and guy clearly states I was getting a lemon croissant. I got raspberry. And I’m allergic :(

Wedding cake tasting!  We set up our first tasting of cakes for the special day with Suzie at the Heidelberg bakery. . We arrived to find a table tucked in a quiet corner reserved for us with a giant book listing a multitude of delicious flavors. Suzie showed up with the 6 cake flavors for tastingthat we head ordered ahead of time. She offered us water and coffee.  Each cake was wonderful. We jotted down our thoughts with each taste.  For of us went for the tasting and we still had box of cake to bring home.

Separately,  the deli and bakery has a smooth, efficient and very friendly system,  there was about 12 folks expertly behind the counters keeping the many eager customers happy.  They  utilize a "pull a number"system which is fair and stress free. They have German meats,  noodles and an amazing array of freshly made bagels,  donuts and cookies. All tempting.

We left appreciating the Heidelberg business model, and with a better idea of our wedding cake and are returning for a second tasting soon.  Great experience.
Neighborhood friendly. Deeply embeded. It's been around a long time.
Delicious soft bread. Friendly staff. Covid hours close at 5 pm.
Carla and her team are thr best bakers!

What an insane bakery. The petit fours are to die for! The cake balls were also a nice surprise. There are so many treats, you truly can’t go wrong. The lines may be a bit long at times, but it’s 100% worth the wait.
The best pastries and bakery in north arlington!
Amazing pastries, breads, cookies. Excellent challa for Rosh Hashana
Fantastic bakery! German themed. Great breads! Wonderful, varied baked goods.
The best bakery...period....
The best pastries and bakery in north arlington!
Amazing pastries, breads, cookies. Excellent challa for Rosh Hashana
The best bakery...period....
Yummy breakfast! Free coffee!!
Delicious so happy this bakery is still around. BTW the napoleons are to die for.
Lovely bakery! The fruit tart is so good. Prices are pretty standard for a bakery. Pretzel bites are like delicious crunchy croutons.

I love this place 😍. I ordered a sandwich on a bagel, it was really delicious and bagel is soft and tasty. Over all love love love it. 10 stars for me. And also you can find more different kind of yummy and delicious treats😍😍😍. Will definitely coming here every day!!!
Amazing place with an amazing selection!

The best bakery in Northern Virginia.  Period. Superb cakes. Excellent bread. Apple Strudel is the best this side of Vienna (Austria). And the people are all so friendly!  We're customers for 43 years.
What can I say?! The best and most extensive selection of pastries, baked goods for miles around. Definitely worth the trip. Enjoy!!
Yum is all I can say.  Great pastries at very reasonable prices.  You can't miss no matter what you get.
Love their pastries. Have been going for many years. Jennifer who assisted us was helpful and hospitable with her suggestions!
Very tasty cupcakes and excellent staff!

Heidelberg is a delicious bakery! I highly recommend the chocolate cream filled doughnuts. They are elusive but you can call ahead the night before and order them. The cronuts are also especially tasty.
Very good german bakery.

Like a kid in a candy store..
Glad I don't live too close to it 🙂
Oooh, the pastry. And bread. Excellent. Ordered specialty bread online and picked it up. Fresh and beautiful.

Love this place! Great bread, pastries and cake. Small selection of German products such as mustard, spaetzle and other specialties. A decent selection of German sausages including my favorite, gelb wurst. Free parking is available and you can even have a cup of coffee there. Recommended!

The quality has gone down. Bought a birthday cake and it was not decorated well at all. So plain, looked nothing like past years or in their website. Was quite disappointed. Still tasted good but after many years of buying their expensive cakes I doubt I'll buy another one again. A shame.

One of the few places you can get actual bread in Arlington. By that I mean good, dense, dark whole grain bread, that makes you dream of German bakeries run by master bakers who work all night so you can can have real bread in the morning. No, it's not cheap, but considering that they have to import flour from Germany to get the right texture, you are getting your money's worth, believe me! Also lots of sweets for sale, but they're not my thing in general, plus they are fortified with four times the amount of sugar you would get in a pastry in Germany, which makes them shockingly sweet... to the American taste just right, I presume. Buy the bread!

The best petite fours I've ever had (even my husband, who hates petite fours, loves these). They take special orders and requests. Their danishes are to die for (stay away from the butter crumb danishes- those are mine!!) and all of the employees are warm and helpful . Not a ton of seating, but we can usually find room. It gets pretty busy (go early if you have your heart set on a particular item!) but there are a lot of people to help you, so you won't have to wait. Nice deli selection and sandwiches. Small imports market, as well. Great, family-owned business.
Very nice shop with lots of great pastry

Delicious breakfast sandwich, donuts are good, free coffee, fast and helpful service. The various sausage/wurst sandwiches are absolutely wonderful, and the deals they have when the grill is set up in the summer are great.
Just awesome. Every category of baked goods available and fresh. Plenty of room to sit and enjoy a quick bite or some coffee. They have good hours and very attentive and friendly staff. 10/10.
They produce some excellent pastry, but you're going to pay through the nose. An alternative to this location is the German Store over on Columbia Pike.
This place been our family favorite for years.

Always awesome. Mid week purchased a few things that were 50% off. Great deal for chocolate croissant and coffee cakes. Jelly pastries as well. Just sad they don't seem to have free coffee anymore. However they have free sample bread and cookies which help the stomach block the view of feet.
It was okay, they had some interesting pastries. I would like to go back and check out the various Meats they had on display as some look like they might be incredibly delicious.
Great little bakery offering traditional German breads and pastries (slightly Americanized) as well as a few common Lebensmittel

I was really excited to visit and try some of the pastries. Unfortunately I was highly disappointed I think the main reason people like this place is because it is not Starbucks or another franchise. I think the items are a bit over priced and don't have any type of memorable or fresh taste. I purchased a pumpkin pie which did not even taste like pumpkin at all. The bread I ordered was not very fresh and the taste was ok. I feel there are other bakeries in town worthy. This place is just ok for me it is not anything special.

Heidelberg is one of my favorite places, just be warned it's a small parking lot that gets busy on Saturday/Sunday mornings. And pre-order (and pay) is a near necessity for holidays (unless you can stop by midday on a weekday. Overall the baked goods are excellent, the service friendly and the prices beyond reasonable. Beyond the croissants, bread, apple turnover and strudels the giant pretzel is a must at all our casual gatherings!
Typical German baking good, very delicious 👍

I love this place. I’m a fan of their pies, sausages, bread, and biscuits. Make sure you try their spicy pumpkin dough during Christmas - to die for!! The quality of their cakes are good, just not exceptional. That said, most people I know that shop there love the cakes. Their coffee is also really good.
I tried their pretzels and they were ok but really not much better than one you can get at a grocery store.
breakfast sandwich was magical. service was great!

Came here on a Saturday during their outdoor bratwurst grilling hours and absolutely loved it. I'll come back again for that. Their backery section inside was quite the selection, but I'm not sure how much of it uses real butter, as compared to substitutes. Overall super good experience though. ☺️
Yummy
Exceptional service, extraordinary product. LOVE LOVE LOVE this place!
Always the best cakes. They did my wedding cake. This is where I go when I don't want to back. Birthdays and holidays.
Always great treats and excellent service.
The best bakery in town.
Lovely local bakery. I would say their breads, pastry, and cakes are the best things there. Pies are very rustic and taste great. Definitely look homemade
A taste of German bakery (and sausages) - baked using German recipes and imported things like Stollen

All the items I've tried here so far have been super tasty. They also do fun events. During my last visit they had an open kitchen allowing you to walk through and see all the baking, have some free samples, and try you hand at making a few things yourself!
Amazing. No other words to describe. Eclectic. Ok, that was another word. Great pastries. Difficult parking because of where they are located, but good food.

Great pastry shop that also has a small but very good deli selection. They often serve free coffee and samples. They also have really good wedding cake options, the almond flavor is so good!

My only issue is they have limited parking.
I'm giving them five stars for their pretzels, brats, pastries, ham salad and Parker house rolls. The staff gets 1 star for rudeness. But, no one goes there for the "friendly" people.
Great pastries and bread. The people are friendly and very helpful. Excellent variety of European/German cheeses, wursts, and cold cuts.
Excellence in pastry

Very friendly, helpful staff; lots of goodies to expand your waist line. I'll have to go back and try the chocolate Nutella eclair. Parking can be tight. They also have a Deli that I haven't tried yet.

So lovely! Give yourself time, the first time you go, because there is a LOT in this shop. I've had sightly better pretzels made by an Austrian in Portland, but they aren't bad here too. And it was nice to find a marzipan good luck charm to send to my mom for the New Year.
Love the HB
Great people and great food.

A classic family-run bakery. Wide variety of breads, fair pricing. Delicious. German specialty items. Also makes sandwiches to go or to consume at a few tables that are set up -- a bit of a (light) breakfast and coffee scene, at least on weekend mornings.
A little pricey but great quality

It's a good bakery with a nice selection of quality baked goods; breads, pastries, donuts, German sausages and a few sides.  On the weekends during the summer they offer various German sausages on rolls.  The prices are a little higher than other stores, but the quality justifies the price for me.  The place can get quite busy and parking is limited, so just be aware.

Great old time bakery that is perfect in 2018. Have been there twice now and both times I was not dissapointed. Very large selection including sandwiches.  Wonderful cookies that are tasty and not covered in sugar.

Great pastries and lots of options to should cater to any ones desires.  They also have a large assortment of marzipan items. Yummie.

Hard to find bakery places like this anymore. Hope they stay in business.
Heidelberg is my go to spot for breads. They also have great donuts and pretzels.
We really enjoy the desserts, but we also love the food too. One of the best lunch deals - a sandwich and a piece of day old cake.

Wunderbar! Meats from a local butcher - Binkert's in Maryland. Homemade pastries, cookies, cakes, breads, chocolates, candies; you name it they have it. Remember to get a number when you enter and enjoy the bakery experience. Go on a Saturday to sample many of their foods and have a warm bratwurst with sauerkraut on a freshly baked bun.

Be prepared to ham it up with tried and true patrons that have been coming here for decades. It's a testament to the authenticity of this bakery. German food products are everywhere. Make yourself a budget because once you see the bounty behind the glass cases you will want everything.

Wow.  The selections are like walking into a 5 and dime store:  you just want to keep looking to discover another hidden gem. Everything looks good,  but I came to pick up some "Berliners" for the office, which others raved about,  but to me weren't anything to right home about,  but breads,  breakfast sandwiches,  cakes and other pastries were looking mighty good.  I'll be back.

A gem in Arlington. This is real food, not some sales joint that has products shipped in. Real German Bakery. And as it turns out on Saturday morning a mini farmers market too.  And on occasion live music.  Great sweets, breads and other treats. Looking for unusual good gifts, this is the place.  Just don't sample on the way home, cause it smells so good, you will be tempted to.
Great quality, good selection, friendly service.
This place is amazing.  They so many different tasty pastries and really good deli sandwiches.  Also the staff is friendly and helpful.

Always good to be here. They have an extensive assortment of pastries and they even have wursts and salami. They didn't grill on the patio today because of the rain, but did grill inside. The wurst roll came with a free piece of cake and besides this they even had a free cookie for my toddler.
We picked a small chocolate cake. It was very good.

A wide variety of pastries and sweet treats - all pretty decent overall. Service is pretty quick in calling out numbers. Prices are reasonable.They also have a picnic area in case you want to eat your desserts right away on a nice day.
Great experience. Fine baked goods, pastries and other treats. Loved the brats & brochen for lunch. thanks.

This is a fantastic local bakery. I went on a Saturday mid morning and it was a little hectic inside. Everything seemed to be moving smoothly and the staff were great. They even had some great suggestions and comments on trying some new things.
Great old fashioned German bakery with good wurst sandwiches
Great place but not as authentic as a few years ago and sometimes overcrowded and often out of items in the early afternoon. We recommend the Brezels and the Beer Cheese.
Fresh baked breads, beautiful cookies, delicious whitefish salad.
So many options and there all delicious!
Doesn't get much better.   Chef Wolfgang and Carla run a tight ship and set the standard in pastries in Arlington, VA.
Soon to be Christmastime at Heidelberg!
Huge variety (not just pastries-they have deli items also), wonderful customer service.  On-site free parking-nice!
Best bakery ! Delicious cakes

My favorite place for pastries! This German pastry shoppe is a staple in the Arlington area. I have ordered the meats, cheeses, lattes, cakes, cookies, oversized german pretzels, and plenty more! The pastries are not overly sweet and are so beautifully decorated.

At it's peak times, it gets quite busy so they have a ticket system. Usually I just try to go in the non-peak hours to avoid the wait.

The parking lot is not big but I've never had any issues finding space. If you do, Heidelberg is located close to a residential area that doesn't require permits to park so customers could temporarily park in the residential area.

Be aware! They are closed on Mondays.

You wouldn't expect a German bakery to make the best bagels in the area, but it does! Get there early on weekends to pick some up before they sell out. They always have free samples of delicious goodies to nibble on while you are waiting to be helped. They also make great, buttery Parker House Rolls. Love their Florentine cookies too.
My new favorite place..

We got our wedding cake here, and the service is a good as the food!

If you haven't tried the food, and don't have a point of reference, you should probably stop reading this and go visit them. Its the best pastry shop in the DMV.
Great experience!
We buy our sliced bread here, the soft pretzels are great, cookies, donuts, yes yes. It's a legendary bakery in Arlington near Falls Church
Always fun and great cakes and pastries. Customize your treat!
Yummy breakfast! Free coffee!!
DELIGHTFUL

Classic European bakery. Great
Holiday goods especially around Christmas.
Delicious cookies, pastries, breads, and cakes. The shop also has some import seasonal goodies.
Traditional bakery with a large amount of pastries, pies, and breads. Serves coffee as well. There is indoor and outdoor seating. Wonderful service, but watch the hours they are open.
Great service. Delicious cookies, bagels, croissants everything. Even good coffee, unexpected from a German bakery. Haven't tried their marzipan delicacies yet, but next time....
Amazing bakery! The gingerbread cookies are the best I have ever had!
The smell as i walked in instantly reminded me of my grandparents German bakery which is the highest compliment i can ever give a bakery.
Absolutely love this place. The pastries, cookies, cakes and bread are delicious. The sausages on the weekends are awesome. The sauerkraut and potato salad taste typical German.

Excellent cakes, pastries, breads, cookies, brownies, doughnuts, plus a German deli counter with delicious frankfurters, bratwurst, bauernwurst, cheeses, etc. even head cheese if you've been looking for that. You can also get a great New Orleans-style King Cake here after New Year's for those who celebrate Three Kings Day on January 6th.
Great products, fast, friendly staff.
Awesome assortment of delicous fresh baked  goods!  Great bread that you cannot get anywhere else.  Very friendly staff.  If you don't come here, your depriving yourself.
Wide selection, knowledgable staff, great baked goods.

Being a transplant from the NJ area I can say that this is the only place in the DMV with real new york style bagels. They don't make a lot of them so if you come in after noon on the weekend you may not be able to get a dozen or your pick of flavors.

They also have great cookies and cakes. My favorites are the seasonal cookies.

Parking can be a pain in the butt though so I'd suggest getting there early.
Always a favorite!
One of my favorite places. When I need a little taste of home (Heidelberg, Germany) I swing by here for a wurst or some sweets
Great customer service.
Always great pastries!

Fantastic food and selections as always, with lots of special holiday items (St Patrick's Day today, but that's true of any holiday). Sometimes service could be better, but it's still an amazing place!
Good but pricey.
Some of the best German food outside of Germany. Parking is not the best. I recommend parking on or across the street to not deal with the small parking lot. Weekends are CRAZY!
Authentic German cuisine.  Lots of dessert options.  Saturday sausage stand is fun.

Great European style pastry shop that also serves sausages and other sandwiches.

Highly recommended!
Awesome desserts!!
This place is absolutely heaven!  All types of baked goods, candies, deli, sandwiches made on the spot, bratwurst bbq on weekends. Inside and outside dining.
Nice peaceful pastry shop environment.  Sandwiches from the deli was decent, but a bit pricey.  I've heard the baked goods and cakes are good, but i've never tried them.
Really good but not really German anymore
Wonderful, chocolate mousse cake and lemon breakfast buns, love it here
It is a little overpriced and the Brötchen could be better. A little disappointed in the quality of the baked goods.

Ah-mazing!!!! Went for a wedding cake tasting and were so happy we did. Yetim was our wedding cake consultant and she was so sweet and accommodating. She helped us pick delicious cake flavors , a design and something that fit well within our budget. My fiance and I are so happy that we went with Heidelberg bakery.
Parking can be a bit tight but we love their baked goods! Very popular.
It's a dream. Part pastry shop, part bakery, part donut shop. Incredible. Don't miss the free coffee at the door on weekends and be sure to grab a number.
A great German bakery in an otherwise nondescript strip of a suburb. Particularly great before Christmas -- get your gingerbread, your marzipan, and every cookie you can imagine, all in one place.
I have been here many times for cakes, pies, and pastries. All of them have always been excellent. Walking in to the shop always puts a smile on your face.
Delicious pastries and cookies! Always worth stopping by when I'm nearby.
Absolutely delicious!

Stop by this morning for breakfa st and some treats for over the weekend. Great selection of freshly ba ked pastries, breads cakes, pies and cookies. The deli counter with local farm free range eggs, homemade bagel cream cheeses, cold cut meats, and deli salads. Did I mention there is a small cafe style seating area for enjoying your coffee and breakfast/lunch. Eating our breakfast treats now on our way to an appointment. Everything we purchased was delicious!
Everyone knows this is a great bakery, but don't forget to come by on the weekend for the sausage cart out front.  Very delicious and a fun environment.
Best kept secret in Arlington. Wish I would have known about this place earlier. Great selection and great taste!
The bakery where time stood still - Our "slice" of Germany in DC.  Great breads, good deals on sandwiches, and many sweets.
If you like German food this is the best place to go in NOVA / DC
Everything is amazing here. Friendly staff. Great bread and pastries. Good for a quick lunch or breakfast.
When I said I got the food for a recent party from this place everyone said Oh - THAT'S why it's *so good.* We will be back.
Ideal place for fresh breads and pastries. You can also have lunch here.
If you like German food this is the best place to go in NOVA / DC
When I said I got the food for a recent party from this place everyone said Oh - THAT'S why it's *so good.* We will be back.
Great assortment of pastries.
One of the best places to get good, proper bread. Over 20 varieties. Also cakes, pastries, sandwiches and European fare.
Wow incredible selection and excellent flavors.  They don't have these in our area
Keep coming back for the bratwurst with saurkraut. They aren't doing the BBQ cart outside nov-may, but they still have the sandwiches inside!
Great assortment of pastries.
Better service than at the Swiss Bakery, but not as easy to get to from the beltway.

A local treasure, German style breads and pastries, a well as deli meats, german sausages (like Weiswurst and Debreziner), and made to order sandwiches. The roast beef is smoked on site, and is worth a visit.
Keep coming back for the bratwurst with saurkraut. They aren't doing the BBQ cart outside nov-may, but they still have the sandwiches inside!
German bakery with amazing breads and cakes/cupcakes...and almost any baked dessert you can imagine.
Mediocre quality, but a nice selection of German style pastry and products.
Great selection of mustards.
Great pastry shop. Their Black Forrest Cake is amazing.
Very good bakery
Great food , pastries, doughnuts,  cookies , coffee, with friendly service !Family owned and operated, the best eclairs in town !
Excellent whole grain and pumpernickel bread.
Great local bakery
Best pastries in town!  I love this place.
Pastries better that we had in Germany last Christmas!
The marsipan is amazing
Fantastic baked goods every time I visit!
The best cakes you can get
Great baked goods all around, and particularly perfect for breakfast pastries.

Very disappointing experience. When we first walked in we immediately noticed the huge selection of not just bakery items but also a little deli meat section as well as some German groceries which we were pleasantly surprised by. A minute after walking around the store a lady walking around the store asked if we were ready and we told her we were still looking. It's a big selection and store so it takes a minute to see everything and figure out what you want. Not a minute afterwards she asked loudly "are you ready yet" . We told her that we were going to order once we were ready to order which took us another minute. grabbed some Bienenstich, Some Napoleons, Some Sacher Torte And some sweet pretzels. The pretzels were good, the cakes seemed to be days old, kept refrigerated. The Bienenstich absolutely not edible, hard and stale. I am from Germany and know what this stuff can taste like, even these would be way better and pretty authentic, but sadly you get days old cakes that are dried out, which such a huge store and selection I guess they can't make everything g fresh daily. Expectations ruined we won't be back.
Leave your diet in the car... and don't speak to it until a few days after visiting... it's SO delicious!
Try the petit fours!  Check out the grill outs during the summer.
Best pastry shop in the world. Very satisfied.
Linzer cookies, hammentashen, brats, doughnuts, coffee, brotchen, and more. All good. On my all time top10 of best food places in USA.
A local institution! Sinfully delicious bakery!
Lots of great food but the petite fours are the best.
Just amazing everything

Definitely a higher tier of restaurant in Blacksburg (finally). Que suerte que tenemos comida Sudamericana en Blacksburg! This restaurant goes above and beyond in most every way. The inside is beautiful, well lit, and has a romantic, suave atmosphere. The wait staff is fast, efficient, attentive, and highly professional. The menu features Brazilian classics at a reasonable cost. Expect to spend $15-30 per entree, depending on how much food you can pack away. The average price is closer to $20/entree unless you feel like eating a 3/4 of a pound of steak. The menu is awesome. You'll find Brazilian classics like picanha, German sausage, roast chicken, chicken hearts, black bean stew, and more. This is a meat heavy menu, as it should be for this cuisine. There are vegetarian options but you should be coming here for meats. You'll also find classics like fried yucca and fried plantains for appetizers. All of the meats we tried were perfectly cooked and seasoned. The quality of the meat and the skills of the parrilla-master are apparent at first bite. The black bean stew and rice was also perfectly cooked and seasoned. The portion size is generous without being overly so. It's hard to overstate how good the food is here!

The beer selection is small but good, and includes a couple of custom beers (including one containing another South American classic-yerba mate). Desserts are a potential weak spot here. The passion fruit mouse was a complete success. The flan was less inspired. The flight of dulce de leche, chocolate, and coconut creams was overly rich. This is just a minor quibble since the entrees are just so good. This is the best restaurant in Blacksburg, in my opinion. Great for a special date or anytime you need to impress. And really great if you want a delicious meal!

This place is great!! If you have some time to spare I highly recommend
The burgers are great not better than five guys but  still tastes great

They have a good variety of food and they don't cook it until you're in line, so it's always hot. The chili cheese dogs to go are very sloppy, recommend asking for a knife and fork. This is one of the only places in the area you can get cheese fries. Sometimes there are too many toppings or too much ice but I don't think that's a complaint.
Freddy has a tasty burger. Topping selection and customization is awesome.  They offer a lettuce wrap burger great for keto diet.
It was my first time and the burgers are really good the beef they use is different and it taste really good. The ice cream 🍨 hits the spot at the end.

The burgers at Freddy’s are so good and flavorful that me personally I feel they are better than Five Guys or shake shack. You can order as many patties as you want and compliment them with fries or even better the fried cheese curds. Their custard desserts are creamy and delicious and they also sell cakes and pies made with their recipes. The place has a vintage diner feel which is very cool. Definitely a great place to take the family.

Good Deserts, havent tried the other food.  Drive Thru needs to pick up like Fast.  Noticed from my going to one when I lived in Texas that they seem to be standing around more.  My dessert should not be trying to melt when I get it.  Besides that not.  Good Concretes, just load up on toppings.
Very delicious burgers and fries! Wish the portions were a little bigger. I was still hungry after eating the double bacon cheese burger with fries. Definitely going back for more!
This is my second time here food was great and love their milkshakes

The food is so go, the custard is to die for, and the service is surprisingly friendly.  They have made a lot of changes to ensure that they and their customers follow COVID protocol. My only suggestion is that they clean their bathrooms a bit more frequently.

It was our first time having food from here and it was very good  mostly but for a semi fast food place it was “way.. too expensive” and if we do come back we will pick select items to get. We have eaten Steak Shack in Florida. Good luck !
Their steak burgers are crispy and juicy at the same time, such a delicious delight! My family really enjoys the shoestring fries as well as their "fry sauce". It's a can't miss!
The food here is absolutely 5+ stars, but the price is quite high for a burger joint. I still keep going back, so it must be worth it!
The custard is delicious and the steak burgers are amazing. Definitely will be going back.

I always forget the regular size sundaes are just a bit too large. Decent burger and custard stand. The matchstick fries are super skinny.I appreciate the drive-thru service but be prepared to wait a while
This has become a local favorite of mine! Particularly when I'm feeling like treating myself! The Cali burger is my favorite and I can't get over how awesome the shoe-string fries and Fry Sauce are!

First of all it is great that they open until late so that you can enjoy late night cravings. Their food and desserts are great. I personally love their sundaes. I tried the one with oreos and gummy worms and it was amazing. Kind of like the dessert hit the spot! Many of the fast food drive through places have very boring dessert choices but here they are fun and worth trying. Try them out and the place is also easy to go in and out even during traffic time! Enjoy =)
Great service and love the food! Where have you been all my life?? Id have pictures but I ate it all too quickly... Maybe next time!
I wish there were more Freddy's in Northern Virginia! Food is always fresh & hot every time

The ticket was right, but the food came out wrong. They also served us two hot dogs that were cold on the inside. Pretty lame. (UPDATE: 28 Dec 2020) I contacted the management team after they reached out and offered an open door. This is a pretty stand-up operation. I am confident they can do better than they did the last time I visited.
I went with my mother to Freddy's Frozen Custard and Steakburgers and their custard and burgers were nicer than Dairy Queen. Burgers were fresh.
Pretty good burgers, unique style. Love their Freddy's sauce. Good for sit down style with group or family.
The burgers are great, love the fries too.
Never heard of it.  Tried it.  Might not be able to forget it!  I think I like the chocolate ice cream the BEST. Nom nom nom

Amazing! Why didn't I try them sooner? Hot, fresh, delicious burgers. Crisp, perfectly salted fries, and a perfect sundae to finish the meal. My new favorite burger place! Definitely coming back to try more of their menus!
Food is always good as well as service. They are taking precautions for Covid & capacity is only 25 inside. Drive thru is of course open. Looks like a long line but moves pretty quickly.
Spectacular! Great family atmosphere and top notch steak burgers. The custard is delicious too

Easily my favorite burger place in the area. The staff is always friendly and the wait is rarely longer than a few minutes.

The food is amazing, though I can only vouch for the steakburger, with some of the best fries at any fast food place I've ever been. The custard is, in it's many variations, definitely worth saving space for and the fact that you can pay for it up front and have it served after your meal is a nice little touch.

Every time I'm back in the area this place is on my must-go list and I suggest you add it to yours.

Friendly fast service. Very clean facility. Everything was prepared properly and the correct temperature.  I hoped to be impressed by the custard and burgers but TBH, they weren't any better than cheaper fast food burgers and shakes/ice cream. I won't take the 20 minute drive to go there but will go again if I'm in the area because of the great customer service and atmosphere.
Best burgers and custard in the area! Staff are friendly as well and the food never disappoints :) I've even met Freddy himself when this place first opened and he is the sweetest and most humble man

Took the boys, we all loved the food. Fries especially were on point.  Chopped steak burgers with gooey cheese mixed in also superb.  Custard creamy and delicious. We are already planning on going back!
These burgers are the BEST!!! I LITERALLY drive from Woodbridge lol
This place is good from a food standpoint. However, the last time we were there they were great frkm a service standpoint as well. Thanks employees for serving your customers well!

Affordable. Tasty. Good customer service. Visited on a weekend so this place was packed but the staff still managed to serve the order in a timely manner and with no mistakes. The place is relatively clean. Their chili cheese fries is a must try. Their burgers are great too. Also try their fries sauces.. so good!
Love, love Freddy's! We drive from Arlington for their yummy burgers - wife loves the veggie burger -- and sweet treats. Be sure to get the app for rewards, but no ordering before 😕.

Great burgers and shoe string fries the best.
Never disappointed

Great custard treats
I only come here for the frozen custard, which is terrific. My current favorite is the nutter butter custard sandwich. I also enjoy the concretes and even the plain frozen custard. I've never tried any of the hot food, so I can't talk about it.
I am really pleased with the way this store is handling corona virus restrictions. All of the employees wear masks, all of the time, and they enforce social distancing.

Dense but good! If you're from the Midwest, it's similar to Culver's. But, I do think the Culver's custard slightly beats Freddy's custard. Service was also a bit slow, but maybe because it's one of the few places in Fairfax that is open later.
Great smash burgers and shoestring fries. Hot dogs area solid too. Spicy fry sauce is a must.

5 Guys lover here, but I think I've officially been converted. This place is Frediculous!

I've been here two times and am in love with their steakburgers and fries! I asked for my #1 lettuce wrapped and this is the best lettuce wrapped burger I've ever had! My mom got a regular #1, and both my brother and dad got #6s. The fries are amazing and are a wonderful combination with their delicious fry sauce.

We also got the turtle concrete (regular sized), which was super melted--but they remade it for us and the second time was the charm.

The staff is very nice and the place is pretty clean! They have indoor and outdoor seating--and the place is pretty spacious! I definitely recommend! I wish they would open another location in Fairfax Station/Lorton area!

It is a bit pricey for burgers and fries...as 4 of us ate for $40 (3 meals, 1 burger, 1 dessert), but it was darn good.

FYI: Concrete vs. Sundae...per employee.
Concrete is sort of like a blizzard with everything mixed in. Sundae is having the toppings on top.

Good for fast food. Filling burger and fries. Update: went back, got the California style burger. It was delicious. I don't know why it was called that, because there was no avocado or nuts or fruit, but it was good. Definitely will recommend

Wasn’t wowed by the steak burgers, they were a little thin and kind of crunchy because they had sat on the grill for a little too long.

I was pleasantly surprised by the fries and the shakes.

Fries were thin and pretty short which made them easy to eat and the shakes were smooth and pretty tasty.

Not sure I’ll go out of my way to come here, but it’s nice place to stop if you’re in the area.
We love Freddy's! The food is always good.  Everything is always made to order and it tastes awesome! I love the drive thru option too, makes it easy to grab or food and go!

Great place with delicious food and friendly staff. We get the burgers and hot dogs, they even have the option of having your burger in a lettuce wrap. A full variety of dessert that they are well known for. Definitely worth a try, they'll have you going back!
Proper food for the price, warm space!
Very fresh food! Fries were hot, burger was old fashion goodness! The wait is a little bit longer since it seemed to be made to order, but worth it.

Freddy’s Steakburgers was a real delight to eat. The nostalgia of an old school burger/shake spot done the right way. I had a California Double and it was very delicious and didn’t feel too stuffed after. Will be back again soon. Highly recommend
Food was awesome. Dining indoors and outdoors was available. Some seating was restricted to ensure social distancing.
Kind of slipping a bit. Drive through very slow and food luke warm.

This place is like a cheaper shake shake with worst buns. It's a solid burger and the fries are pretty good.

If you are looking for a smash burger and you can't make it to shake shack, this place will do.
Good to sell sauce bottle.

Freddy's has great burgers, hot dogs, french fries (get some fry sauce, I like it better than ketchup). The patty melt is my go to here, while my kids like hamburgers, cheeseburgers, and hot dogs. They also have chicken sandwiches.   That said, the entrees are simply a delay to get to the custard-cones, concrete, shakes-all very good. There is quite a bit of indoor seating (busy on weekend nights) and outdoor seating when the weather is good (or if you are immune to the cold). Highly recommend, family friendly (high chairs, booths, tables).
The ice cream in cups are served with a lid, therefore everything gets smashed down and stuck to the lid.
Awesome smash burgers and crispy thin fries. Well worth the drive and the wait. Can’t wait to come back and try the custard too.

The food is great when it's great. Unfortunately, the quality is not consistent. During some visits, it's absolutely a 5 star experience for the price. During other visits, the food is borderline inedible (cold, undercooked, soggy, etc).
Real 🍔 with killer fry sauce. Can't go wrong with dessert either.
The best burgers and love the skinny French fries...always made fresh after you order.  And the root beer floats are wonderful.
That drice thru is horrible, never again

I had the double cheeseburger California style, chili cheese fries, and the Turtle sundae custard. They were great and exactly the kind of food I was looking for! It's not gourmet, it's just fatty comfort food.
Best burger spot in the DC area. HANDS DOWN
I wish the size if the burgers were bigger. But the ice cream was bangin
Just great food.
Large portions, you could share fries and sides.
Great hidden spot that you should definitely try!

Took it back and for another with almond n very few. It appears that they were out of both nuts as the young lady said.  First bad experience there .

I like it. Always seems fresh, reasonably priced. Shoestring fries are a nice change of pace from many offerings. I wish they had gluten free buns. The frozen custard is good and a good value. Always good service for quick serve food.
Good taste and excellent portion.
Always friendly staff.
Consistency is key, this place hits the mark every time. Make sure you try the Concrete...simply amazing.

Awesome, quality food with a great selection for the entire family. Service was incredible and quick. I will definitely return and will definitely recommend to anyone.
If you are unsure what to order I suggest trying the cheese curds.
Good food an Service!!

Love the burgers here!  Great place for families with delicious frozen custard for dessert.  Staff is always super friendly.  Even when the line is long it moves fast and food arrives quickly.  I just wish it was closer to where we live!
High quality fast food.  Delightful ice cream and shakes...tried chocolate with cherries. Yum
Awesome burgers and fries
Burgers are delicious. Fries were nice and thin...so tasty
you can always count on great service with a smile to go along with amazing food and frozen treats
Love their burgers and cheese curds.
It was tasy and the location was fine. But $9 for the type of "burger" they serve is a bit insulting. I have gotten much more food if equal quality from other places.
It's a little pricey but good

Burger was thin and cooked with crust for taste.  I would recommend the double since the burgers are very thin.  Fries were crisp and hot, the super thin shoestring type. Place looked clean but noisy.  Service was quick and friendly.   A bit crowded for a late lunch/ early dinner around  230pm.
The frozen custard is outstanding and the burgers are always great.
Really love Freddy's. Great burgers and even better custard. Drive thru lines are really long right now since no one can go inside, but it is worth the wait.
I really enjoyed the food and the staff are nice. There  chili cheese fries were great and milk shake was good as well.
Super good burger and fries. Great staff!
Steak n Shake Freddy Style 😉 They deliver a great cheese burger, outstanding chili cheese fries, and shakes made with real frozen custard and milk.
Can't go wrong with fresh steak burgers

If you gonna order a chick burger, I think for my opinion their grilled burger truly ROCKS! Their selections of beef burger are great!  I think almost everything in the menu was great, also you might wanna know that this place is among the favorite burger places for Americans who live in the region, and I would encourage anyone around to go forward with it!

The food is great. The prices are a little high, but you pay for quality.

I'm probably not returning though. I get that a burger place probably isn't where you wanted to work, but I don't need the attitude. Really good ice cream and burgers. 100% reccomend to anyone and will definitely be going back sometime soon!
Delicious original burger and nice fries. Will come back to try the custards.
Great burgers and shakes. The best fast food place.

Meeh burger and fries, expensive,
I will go to mellow mushroom or 5 guys instead
Fast service at the drive through.

First time trying this place and we were so glad that we did. Service was great. We came on mother's day for a latte lunch so it was pretty busy. There was a couple of dirty tables but it was understandable giving the situation. When the staff did have the time the tables were cleaned right away. On to the food.... I got a double with bacon and cheese. It was a good burger! The chili cheese dog I wish I could have gotten it cooked a little more. I don't like a burnt dog but this should have been cooked a little longer. The chili had great taste and the fries was awesome! We will be back!

I did not like the string style fries. They had a strange fish taste especially considering they dont have fish on the menu. The hamburger was good. Very family friendly place but it was too hectic for me. Kids were running around everywhere.  Too much going on.

Love, love, love this place (however, see note below). The steakburgers are the bomb. And love the thin fries and fry sauce!

But PLEASE keep it cleaner or I won’t be able to eat here anymore. Floors, windows, table tops, drink area, etc is so absolutely DISGUSTING!!!
Their food is sooooo good, I can eat their fries all day.
Bacon Cheeseburger was tasty and hot. French Fries were shoestring style perfectly cooked and the fish was tasty and hot. Quick service and moderate pricing. All in all a great dining experience.

The first time I ever visited Freddy's was in Junction City, Kansas when I was visiting my niece. I just loved it. I never knew there was one so close to home. I'm so happy there is. Just wish you were in Gainesville, VA. It would be so much closer.
Good experience and the staff was awesome special the lab person Mr. Zarif. Thanks for everything
Great service, food choices, reasonable prices and great desserts!
Very good food. Tasty and hot.
LOVE the history AND the support of military; but oh, so sorry to say, nothing spectacular food 🍔🍗🍟or service. All just okay. Upside, way better than typical fast food and has custard too! 🍨

Best operating partners and staff by far. Been to many Freddy’s but the Fairfax City Virginia location makes the rest look like beginners.
Great service and amazing food!
Tried a burger and a brownie sundae. Amazing.
Great place and the Drive-thru was super fast.

First time to visit Freddy's. The burger was great and onion rings good. Very engaging staff and fast service. Ice cream items looked good and many people were ordering them. Stop by if your in the area.
Always great!

Their custard was to die for. All the food was so insanely good and their fry sauce paired with their seasoning was absolute perfection to my taste buds. 10/10 recommend and will bring any visiting family or friends
Great food
Hawaiian Delight Sundae with a Chicago dog.
I love Freddy's in Fairfax. Very friendly staff, I always get my food quicky and it's hot and accurate. We have gone during busy times along with the slow periods and it's always consistent.
Good burgers and custards

Great food - great price
Great frozen desserts for a quick late night snack. Prices are a little higher than you'd expect but not bad overall
Good burgers and fries. Great throwback atmosphere. You'd be surprised not to find a jukebox of 45s...
Discovered this burger joint at a playdate. Friendly staff. Kind people. Good food. Nutter Butter is a special treat 😋
Too much salt on the burgers.

The drive thru, which is the only option during covid and hasn't changed, is extremely slow at any reasonable time during the day. Fair warning, expect a wait time of 10 to 25 minutes idling in the drive thru just to get to the window. Why is there no alternative?
Best burger and concrete combo in Northern VA

For frozen custard, burgers and fries it can't be beat! Also they serve hotdogs! Not just shakes but also malts too! I'm not in the area often but I stop here every time I am. And the food and service is great everytime!

Best burgers around and their fry sauce is my favorite!  Dessert is great too.
Employees are super friendly which is extra nice.

The only thing wrong with Freddy's is that we have to travel 60 miles to get to it. But it is worth the drive. Make sure you add chili to your "burger" and to your fries - mmmmm. The add a Snickers Concrete for dessert.
Drive thru was quick and the employee was kind. My order didn't have any issues. Their fries are a bit salty. I like them but I would order salt free if possible if you don't like salty food.

What's not to love about a thick frozen custard and seasoned shoe string fries?  The chops steak burgers are so juicy and always hot from the grill. I also love that I can get a lettuce wrap instead of a bun!
Good burgers and make sure you get the rewards app if you go here often to get free food and ice cream.   Good soft serve ice cream as well
A burger and frozen custard are my go to when here.  There can be a line but it goes fast.
Great tasting food and great service!

Great place for burgers and fries. Beats Five Guys EASILY in my opinion. I will say that the last couple of times I went, the meat was less seasoned than prior visits, but still better than the competition!
Was better than expected

This place has very good service and tasty custards.  Today my wife and I stopped in for some lunchtime dessert. She had  2 scoops of vanilla custard in a waffle cone and I had one scoop vanilla custard with chocolate chips on top in a cup. The outside tables set the mood just right for our dessert date lol. Thank you Freddy and staff for helping me show my number one lady a good time!
Personnel is mostly high schoolers. Nice service for a fast food place. Clean and maintained.
An enjoyable atmosphere in a clean friendly environment.  Food was timely tasty and warm. I love shoestring fries.
Excellent, superior zfrozen custard - especially the chocolate!! Burgers are too thin for my taste, but the thin fries with fry sauce are addictive! Go!!

I loveeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee Freddys. it is my favorite fast food. if u have not tried Freddys then go try it. I love this restaurant! Your food is extremely good. If you haven't had a steak burger you absolutely have to go here. I would definitely recommend the fries and cheese curds.

First experience and it definitely won’t be the last.  The burgers were perfectly cooked and well seasoned.  The fry sauce is delicious.  After dinner we enjoyed a concrete custard and I was very impressed.  I told them I had an allergy to tree nuts and they wash everything before making my dish.  The scoops, the machines they take such care to make sure mine doesn’t come into contact with any allergens.  I very much appreciated this as I have had an allergic reaction from an ice cream store before.  Will absolutely be returning!
Best Custard in Virginia
Really good burgers, amazing fries, and the crispy chicken sandwich can rival the ones from Chik fil A. I highly recommend this place for a good, family friendly, group friendly, high quality meal.
Great burgers fries and yummy thick custard shakes. Had many of my kids sport teams meet here. Plenty of seating.

I love your food even though, you forgot my onion rings, and you make my ice cream too early and its melted by the time I get to the window and still have to drive home with it. They've got delicious burgers and a wide range good menu. Everytime I think of them I want to go eat.

Boy is this place good! Delicious burgers and heavenly frozen custard for dessert...

One of the best possible burger places available. Their burgers are actually strips of steak. They have the best custard. The service is amazing and the food comes out pretty quickly. Great place to go if you are on a tight schedule.

Great veggie burgers. Great kids menu. The location is off in the cut, so SLOW down or you might miss it. Speedy turn out. Ordered for 6, food came out faster than expected. Fries are small too, which was odd, but equally delicious. Aces in my book.
Found this place by accident.  Best ice cream cone I’ve had in a long time.  Would have given 5 stars but I would prefer somewhat lower prices.  Will definitely be coming back.
The steak burgers are always delicious. Service is fast. Staff is polite and helpful.  This is one of my favorite restaurants.
Good food, friendly service!  Great atmosphere like an old timey diner!  The frozen custard and the cheese curds are especially fantastic and I have yet to taste anything here I don't actually like.

Today was our first time here. I got the California burger and chili dog combo. Huge portions. Loaded burger, tons of fries. And the custard was amazing. My husband is now in love with this place. It was so good. We'll be back.
Friendly, we take a group of 10-15 people, move  tables, they dont mind. Ice cream is Best around

I only get the custard when I'm here because Rita Frozen Custard is only open during the summer and sometimes a girl just wants custard even if it's the winter. Always delicious. It takes a while when you order but that's it's freshly made.

Great!  Loved the feel and the history pictures (not vouching for fact vs his-story...). I was not aware of the [signature features] being thin meat patties - presumably for the steak aspects - and shoestring fries. It was a great meal. Oh, and frozen custard, but that goes without saying, pretty hard to mess that up.
Some of the best fries in the fast food business. Always crispy.  One of the few places around here to get a Chicago dog.

This place is the best at whatever price when it comes to burgers and fries. Excellent burgers, fries, bread, pickles, and sauces.  Their spicy fry sauce is great. Their prices are reasonable (Age 55+ 10% Senior discount available on certain weekdays).
Consistently delicious and always a crowd pleaser, Freddy's never disappoints!
What a great burger! Tastes like real ingredients that haven't been cheapened to save a few cents. One of my new favorites.
This place. It's good.

Came here not expecting anything special. Boy was I in for a surprise. The food was excellent and the customer service was exceptional. Will be returning !
The philly steak is amazing. Finished the meal off with a regular dirt n worm custard.

burger and patty melt were good, chilli and cheese on fries ok, cheese curds amazing.

took home theur jalapeno sauce and steakseasoning which were bomb.

concrete was ok

Custard is overwhelmingly sweet [but that may be my personal preference for less sugar].  Kids love their shoestring french fries.

Pretty good, and I liked that they have a veggie burger option. The food seemed old fashioned in a good way, with shoestring fries and really good ice cream. I will definitely stop by again if I am in the area.

Great custard!  Thick and creamy!  Waffle cones are tasty.  Love the toppings - marshmallow cream is decadent!  Sometimes there's a wait line.  Free parking - some are a little tricky since the parking spots are tucked in every corner.  Worth the wait and the parking.

Great burgers and shakes. I really appreciated that an employee came by our table to make sure everything was good, he even asked if there was anything he could get us. Fantastic customer service! Looking forward to going back.
Awesome burgers

Great food with a nice old timey feel.
Staff was friendly and helpful, and the establishment was clean and well kept

Surprisingly great!  The burger was great, the chicago dog was good, and I actually stopped after 75% of the chocolate custard because it was so satisfying & delicious.  My little boy, who normally eats half a hamburger pattie at other places, ate 4 patties 😀, two orders of fries, and the cherries of his custard (too cold...he's picky right now). As good as it gets... Cooked to order, and nothing like the usual fast food.  And try the Fry Sauce..
Super friendly staff and good food. We love the Fairfax VA location because the kids can play at the play ground behind the restaurant after eating.
Great ice cream (custard). I think they're a good alternative to in n out.
Great food.  Excellent customer service.

Consistently good. Fries are delicious and never greasy. The burgers are great: flat and flavorful and also not greasy. Service is good, but there can be a line. A very different take on burgers and just goofy e Pugh to be fun.
My wife and I always look forward to coming here. Their food is always great and consistent. The staff are always welcoming and give off good vibes. Definitely stop by if you’re in the area.

Great food and service. Staff is super friendly and helpful!
Freddy's has some of the best food in Fairfax!

Great food and desserts.
Meh not the worst. Good atmosphere
