Good food.  Usually pretty loud, mainly the music, which they have set to a Florida station.

Best burgers in Fairfax (to my knowledge). I believe that they do not put the patties on the grill until you order so you always get that hot-off-the-grill experience. Their custard is very good and their employees are very friendly and well trained. I appreciate that they give back to the local community as well.
Delicious burgers, crisp fries, fast service, custard is fantastic!
Great food and very satisfying dessert options. Yes, it gets crowded very easily, though the staff still crank out the orders in a reasonable time.
Great food, but the guy taking orders at the drive through was very catty and condescending. Certainly needs improvement in regards to customer service.
Freddie's food is fab! And the custard is to die for. A fun family restaurant, with friendly,  efficient service. One if my very favorite fast food places to take the grandchildren!

One of the most chill places to go if you want a good burger. I love the atmosphere here. Been coming since they opened up in 2014 and have never had bad service. The manager recognizes me every time I come and I always end up getting extra fries, even when I don't ask for it. They always come and drop my food off rather than calling my number for me to come pick up me food. I will continue to come here for years and have told many people who only come here when they crave a good burger.
Great burgers, cheese curds and concretes!

One the best places to get a burger. The custard is phenomenal. Shoe string fries... Amazing. Need I say more? This place is family friendly and has lots of big seating tables if you have a group of 6 or more. I am excited to go back. Don't forget the cheese curds!
Good burgers and hot dogs and really good custard.  I'm not a big fan of the shoestring fries though.  Fast and friendly staff.
One the best burgers 👌 had in a long time.
Just left this location, the young girl at the window with glasses Terrible attitude
1st timer. Drive through was quick, and service was friendly and efficient! Ice cream tasted good.

The frozen custard confections are the best. Sundaes, concrete (all the ingredients mixed in), and milkshakes in every flavor they offer -  and there's a long list!  My favorite sandwich at Freddys is the #5, kind of a patty melt on grilled toast.  Well worth a try next time you go. I've also liked every seasonal special; so keep an eye out for those.
Burgers could be better! Too thin to be called Steak Burgers. Shakes are good

Burger and fries were pretty good.  Their Sauces and seasoning are what make this place though. I wasn't even that hungry and enjoyed my food.  I also got a Worms in Dirt Sunday and thoroughly enjoyed it as well. Though the toppings were a bit limited leaving a big bowl of normal vanilla custard.
Tasty classic burgers, shakes, and fries joint.  I thoroughly enjoyed the crispy edges of the burger patties and fresh pickles. Yum.
A little pricey but delicious. All the food is good but I go there especially for the frozen custard,  which is hard to find in this area. Custard serving sizes are large. Has a drive through.

They forgot to pack all 4 straws and sloppily put together one of the two pattimelts ordered. Also they asked what sauces but only packed two ketchup and two fry sauces for several order of fries.   The one in Fredericksburg is much more preferred and efficient.
They have a great service, great food!! Definitely come back again for some lunch on weekends! They will give you discount if you are military or even ex-military!

Burgers and fries! If I lived closer to this place I'd go more often, but as such, it's a guilty pleasure for my family.  We go every so often as a special treat and Freddy's never disappoints.  I love the burgers, love the fries and I love the ice cream!  A great place to bring the family, and the staff is always friendly.
I love this place! The burgers are always fresh. The staff is always super nice and the custard is to die for! Great restaurant, I just wish there was one closer to my house :)
Amazing burgers! Plus they serve custard 😍
First time coming here and I'm sold. Great burger and burger options. Great price. Great people working behind the counter. You literally need nothing else.

Best thing about this place is you can order your dessert (custard) when you order your food but have them delay making the ice cream until you're done with your meal.  The food is ... ehh.  Salty, greasy burger faire.  Perfect for certain situations,  You could find better, they just won't  have such awesome desserts.

We loved Freddy's, always the best steakburgers, wonderful fries, and frozen custard. I have moved from this area so it was great to have the chance to be back near Freddy's. If you want the best, head to Freud's, you won't regret it.
Unexpectly good. Only my 2nd time at a Freddie's

Classic, old school decor, traditional style burgers & drive-in soft serve. All the employees are truly gracious and completely customer service oriented! Try them out today for a good old fashioned meal

They did great with the ingredients they had to work with I thought the burgers were going to be a little more filling. the customer was out of this world plus you can get a pup cup for you little buddy if you have one with you. All in all such a great experience I couldn't imagine anything better from such an affordable eatery.

Tried the steakburger. I wasn't sure what to expect. It was basically a steak'em on a hamburger bun. The flavor was good but some of it was a little crunchy.  Can't wait to try the frozen Custard! :-)

Good service, reasonable prices. Personally Im not so sure how much I like steak burgers, they are kind of flat and crunchy on the sides. But the service is quick, the toppings are fresh, and the fries are the extra thin cut kind. Free sauce for the fries. Its a pretty decent place, Ill probably be back in a few montha.
Fantastic. Food really does come hot and fresh as advertised (and was delicious) and the custard is addicting
Great food great service and always a lively atmosphere
Very nice experience. Good food in general. The shakes are Good!!! Excelent!
This was a surprise find. We thought it would be like every other chain and it wasn’t! The burgers are really good and the desserts and delicious too!
Better than BK, MCD, Wendys, arbys and so on. Good burgers, fries and obviously their frozen custard.

This was my second visit, and it left me puzzled and disappointed. Ordered a patty melt, and it was lay in the basket poorly assembled or coming apart. Didn't whoever set it on the counter care? I didn't pursue it...just ate it with plastic knife and fork. What the hell; I was hungry, but felt dissed. Fries on this occasion way too salty; fountain drink not well-balanced between soda and syrup. And, the custard is expensive. Will give Freddy's another chance, but for a place that trumpets itself as special, this was a disillusionment. This branch needs new, or better-focused management.

This is definitely a family favorite we come all the time we have a fun time there it is a place of many memories ❤️.  The custard is the bomb! But the workers were forgetting  our order and we normally have to repeat ourselves.
Clean and fast, food is great.
Very fresh and tasty.
Steak burgers and great ice cream treats!!

Classic American burger joint! You know its clogging the arteries in your soul when you eat it...but you keep eating AND get a milkshake. Only reason I gave it 4 stars is because there was not enough staff to bus tables and bathrooms need to be cleaned.
Amazing custard. Great hamburgers, just like steak n shake except they use Pepsi products.
GREAT steakburgers! Easily as good as that other restaurant.

Love this place, fresh made hamburgers, I like the chili cheese fries.
Very good customer service!
Burgers are great.  Service is fast.  Fried Cheese Curds are AMAZING.
The manager (owner?) always friendly.  Good service and team.  Food always quick considering how busy they are.  Recommend  the custard sandwiches.

The food is usually pretty good. I had the single steak burger combo. Their fries are really good. They are shoestring fries and are nice and crispy. Didn't have ice cream on this visit, but it's usually pretty good too.
Longer wait for fresher food however the fries are so skinny that if you don't eat it right away it goes cold. Staff was great though.

This place has a retro-burger feel to it. The fries are shoe-string style and I wish there was more to it. The burgers are smashed and very very thin and have a nice crisp to it. Unfortunately for the price it is not very filling. The custards are a sugar bomb but very good. Interior is clean and management/staff works hard. Probably would go on occasion but not out of my way.
Its pricey fast food place. Everything is fresh for sure, they do take a little bit more time than the usual fast food places but its worth it. I love the fries here as well as their hot dogs.
Clean, friendly, tasty, nostalgic.
Great food. A change up in flavor from typical fast food places. Definitely a favorite.

Freddy's has the feel of an old fashioned burger and shake shop. It is clean with a nice welcoming atmosphere. The staff are always friendly. The food is prepared when ordered and is usually ready pretty fast. The burger patties are really thin (and a bit salty), but very tasty. The fries are also very thin and very good, like shoestring potatoes. I still haven't tried the frozen custard, but it looks great. One of these days I'll have to give the custard a try.
Came for a sweet cold treat. I ordered a large chocolate custard in a waffle cone. It turned out to be 3 large scoops of chocolate custard. Wow, delicious!!

Customer service and cleanliness on point. Food lack luster on this particular visit. Fries were neither fresh or hot. Lettuce on my burger must have come from the bottom of the containers as I got a lot of water that made my bun soggy.
Prices are a bit steep for hot dogs, burgers and fries and ice cream but the food is absolutely wonderful!  Especially the onion rings!
Steak burger and frozen custard were excellent.   Fast service

Awesome food and the register guy patiently helped me and my family decide what we wanted based on dietary preferences. Way to go the extra bit. Then later he came by to see how we like our food. We have nothing but good things to say.

A must try burger spot!!!
And the frozen custard and deserts alone are a reason to come here
Awesome burgers. Awesome staff. I sometimes get free shakes brought to our table just because. Awesome place... The Burgers are awesome. To they are thin but getting a double or triple layers the cheese and makes them awesome. The Freddie's sauce is awesome too. Hard to find good burger sauce like this.  The place has chilli cheese Fry's as well!
Tripple burger California style reminds me of in n out not as a exact replica as the place in Maryland caliburger that was sued by in n out but a good replica and good burger.

Awesome food.
Awesome custard.
Good customer service.
50's atmosphere, Great burgers, lots of ice cream options; this place is the most budget friendly I seen around.
So good! Not a huge fan of the fry sauce though but it's neat they have it. Fairly cheap prices and the staff is always nice. It's also pretty clean and tidy.
Good burgers and frozen custard
Very unique thin patty burgers and thin fries to match
Burger place with interesting dipping sauces.....service was good

Extremely good custard! I got something simple for my first time there (a vanilla shake with hot fudge) and it was so good! I also had a burger and fries. They serve shoe string fries and they were very good with the jalapeño fry sauce. I reccomend stopping by!

I wrote a rave review about the food and custard a month ago.  But this time, I tried the drive thru.  I sat in line without it moving for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile all the folks behind me backed out and left.  I finally bailed and left too.  Although the food is good, it seems that many of the staff are wildly unprepared and dismal and doing their job quickly.  I watched TWO employees do box recycling instead of staffing the restaurant during the busy lunch hour.
The food is good but incompetent staff and management outweighs that greatness of the food.  If you are gonna drop 11 for a burger and fries, expect they can provide it in under 10 minutes.
If the manager cannot hire more staff or competent staff, this franchise WILL GO UNDER.
Great custard, good food, friendly service.  I wish they could keep the tables cleaner during peak business.
Great frozen custard and steak burgers.  Very good price
Very greasey, not very clean. If they clean up, they have good custard.
Excellent service and food. I have only visited a few times but received great service each time. Keep it up....Few months later and feel the same way.
One of my favorite places to visit. Love the fries, burgers and of course the ice cream!
Very family-friendly, food comes out pretty quick. Music is PG or PG-13. No complaints at all, the big cool thing is the outside patio and the Plenty full parking everywhere
The patty melt was too salty and small for the price. I only ate half. The fries were good.

My FAVORITE burger place. I can eat the entire burger without feeling sick like I do at most places (5 guys) and they fries are so good! Only downside is they don't give you enough fries (even with a large meal). I don't eat a lot and I can finish a large meal and still have room for desert.
Outstanding value and flavor!  Great Frozen Custard that is so smooth, it's hard to describe.  Delicious food.  Clean, comfortable, fun.  Brightly lit with a fun retro vibe.

I went to the Freddy's in Fredericksburg a while ago and I was craving it, so I decided to go to this one because it was closer. I went on a Saturday and the parking was beyond horrible. I rode around the parking lot several times until I finally got a spot. The ice cream on the other hand was great, which is what I went for. It was rather busy, which was expected. The was no where to sit,  inside or outside, but it is right beside a park so luckily it was nice outside so I sat on a park bench and enjoyed my sundae. All and all it was worth it.
If you like burgers alot come HERE
4th time at this establishment and I must say the consistencey of the food is incredible.  The ambaince of the restaurant is so dead on for the 50's.  Service is fast and accurate!!!!!

Visit on a Friday night early summer. Almost every order in the place including ours was wrong. They lost our shake order (how?) And there was a colony of ants over taking the tables outside. All garbage cans were overflowing, condiment station was empty, restaurant exhaust wasn't working so it was smokey. I have seen it more crowded but better run so not sure what was going on.
Food is OK. Eating area could be maintained better
Very clean, great food, and great custard! Felt a little bad we went about 40 minutes before they were close in but they were totally cool with it! Also the food only took about 7 minutes.

Really thin, crispy on the edges and still juicy burgers. Might be too high in salt. They taste great and their thin fries and sauce are a nice change, but if you're watching your salt intake, you might want to review the nutritional content first.
I love their original steak Berger
I always order the vanilla custard and regular steakburger. They are worth it. Clean place and friendly staff. I will be visiting again.
Love eating here!
Wonderful hamburger place. Worth the price.
The food is good but not amazing. Worth a stop to mix up your burger locations

This place is the best if you are dining in.  I would avoid the drive thru if you are in a hurry.  It's slow. I get it that all orders are made to order but I have to repeat myself over and over because the person working the window never gets the order right the first time. Dining in = best.  Drive thru = meh.

Good place to get a quick bite. delicious steak burger which isnt that greasy. No long line (usually) and has lots of tables. But personally i think size is quite small for what you pay. But overall good place.
Yummy
I love this place.  The burgers are unique and very good.  So are the fries and shakes.  It's real busy at prime times and hard to get a table.
Love this place!! Stop here everytime I'm in Fairfax. delicious burgers and frozen custards.
My favorite burguers places. When I want to eat a good burguer I just go to Freddy's.

Fast(ish) food the way it should be! Quality ingredients, friendly service, reasonable prices, retro atmosphere. I highly recommend the steakburgers and concretes. Definitely try their Fry Sauce with your fries and onion rings!
Great burgers and custard with a side of nostalgia. Visit here every time I am in the area.
Delicious steak burgers. Great variety. Onion rings really crispy.
Delicious burgers, hot dogs, french fries and everything in between.  This is a fun little place with reasonable prices.  I challenge you to try to not have a great day after you've eaten here.
Very tasty and awaiting! A bit spendy though
Awesome burgers and fries, and super creamy custard to boot!! The staff is very nice as well - they even come around and ask if need anything and help clean empty trays. How's that for fast food!?

Good food, depending on when you arrive, could be a slight wait.
All in all still fairly quick, and good service.

Great food, prepared fast.  Staff is friendly.  Lately, orders are missing items and portions inconsistent at times. Attribute to revolving door high school age staff not being managed properly on QA/QC. Otherwise, a favorite go-to.

Nice fast food burger joint. Chickfila aesthetic, but with steakburgers and frozen custard. Good food, always been hot and fresh for me. City playground and soccer fields right behind. Drive thru and patio tables. Great for families with kids.
Great place! I actually had their fish this time! It was good!

Great place for a quick, delicious burger. Building is clean, employees are friendly and the food is always fresh. Drive thru is available, although I am unsure about the wait times for it. Every now and then, due to the amount of people that pack the place, your food might take slightly longer than normal, but it's not a normal occurrence (at least at the times I have gone). Loads better than most (if not all) Fast Food joints in the area. This place definitely sticks out. Five stars for Freddy's!
The best burgers in Fairfax.  After the burgers and fries,  you can add a delicious ice cream novelty or sundae.

Burgers are normally great, sometimes its a hit or a miss. Their shoe string fries are always delicious, as well as their very own seasoning and fry sauce. To top it off they give GMU students a discount.

Great food, reasonable prices, good service. I had the double bacon Steak burger even though I've never liked a steak burger, I loved this one. The fries were pretty great, shoe string style fries were great especially with the complimentary Freddys famous steak burger and fries  seasoning on every table; no ketchup needed. The custard was also great I had the mini pbc&b sundae. I posted a picture of the menu but like I said the prices are reasonable.

Love love love this place!! The burgers are great, the fries we cant get enough of (especially with some of their fry seasoning and special sauce), and we wrap it up with a delicious custard concrete! Can't go wrong with Freddys!!
Pleasant experience.. Good food, always good service.  Try your burger in a lettuce wrap, you won't be disappointed.
Great service even later at night. Ice cream here is awesome! The burgers aren't too shabby either, set back off the road slightly in the same lot as Hooters.
Old fashioned burgers and shakes

If you like burgers you have got to come here. Best steak burgers in Fairfax, VA. I do recommend eating in instead of take out. The management goes out of their way to please it's costumers. Well done and keep up the excellent job.
Great food and nice people very family friendly place
Food is good.  Place could be cleaner; tables were dirty.  Ice machines weren't working. Everyone loves the frozen custard.
Great frozen custard!

This is one cool restaurant! Everyone here is smiling and having fun gobbling their steakburgers and custard and not necessarily in that order! The patty melt on rye is very tasty and the double burger with the super fresh lettuce and tomato really hits the spot. Freddy's is our new go to burger spot!
Veggie Burgers and of course Freddy's Fries 😍 Great Service Definitely A Fairfax City Family Go To or if your just passing through . It's worth it to go
I was surprised to find a veggie burger on the menu! Service was fast and friendly, and the restaurant was spotless, even the bathroom! Freddy's is what every fast food chain should aspire to.
Straw fries and Steak sandwiches. Love coming here for lunch.
Bruh..... this place is LIT! The food is delicious and the custard is bomb!!!!! Very impressed! Will return!
Very family place, food with quality. Employers polite and helpful.
They got some good ice cream I still wanna try the food
Wonderful customer service! My toddler spilled her milkshake as soon as I handed it to her. They fixed us another one and gave us plenty of napkins. Keep up the good work!
Good food. Dine in or drive thru. Love their food and the ice cream. Staff is friendly and they aim to please. Accepts Mason Money as well!!! Great eats!
Not very good. Would not go again.
Fast and friendly service!
Cool little place that was brought to my attention. Easy location to get to and great prices. The fry sauce is incredible.
Great food and service.
Fantastic burgers. The one I've ordered has a thin slice of steak on top of the burger. Very unique burgers that are mouth watering.
Everyone was having fun. Loved it.
The food is amazing!! Love this place!!

I have never eaten at a Freddy's. I had no idea what to expect. I ordered the dbl patty melt not realizing it was rye bread. I dispise rye. But it was an excellent burger. If you can make this guy like rye, you get 4 stars at least. The staff was nice, the food was good and fast. I will return.
Just had lunch for the 100th time. Always a pleasant staff willing to go the extra mile for the patrons. Great burgers and fries. Always a fan favorite with my wife and kids.
Great burgers at an affordable price. Fast drive-through service. Nice people.

Similar to Steak n Shake, but better. Order at the counter and they either call your number or, if they're not too busy, they'll bring it to you. Burgers are yummy, fries is perfectly crisp, frozen custard yummy. Service always with a smile. I'm eyeing the cakes with ice cream AND cake for my birthday.

This was our first visit. We ordered burgers and desserts. They let us hold off on getting the desserts until we finished our food. Burgers came out faster than expected. The reason is the patties are thinner than usual burger joints. But the thinner burger was not a negative in this case. I got a patty melt which comes with 2 patties. (The regular burgers come with 2 patties) The pattie melt was delicious and hot. I could still see steam coming off the meat. I was not too impressed with the thin shoe string fries but the portion was fairly large and they were included in the price. I could not finish all my fries. Plus I had to save room for dessert. I ordered my staple dessert, hot fudge Sundae. The custard was excellent. The point price vs. portion was spot on. Meaning you get what you pay for. And I can't forget the staff, they are nice, helpful, and attentive to our needs. I would visit more offen but it's a bit out of the way from where we live and work.

Good quality food. Love the Freddy sauce on both their burgers and fries, including chili cheese fries. And for a fast food/"fast casual" place their service is excellent, you can definitely tell they emphasize great service.
Burgers were awesome! Almost as awesome as in-n-out! The frozen custard was just okay to me..nothing too special. Maybe I have to try a different flavor next time!
Great food; great service.
Very yummy steakburgers and fries here, not to mention shakes and sundaes! Polite staff and quick counter service.
Pretty good hamburgers. Hot dogs are good. Shoestring fries are real good especially with the fry sauce. Great ice cream custard.
Always an excellent experience. Delicious steakburgers, good service, clean place.
Thin fries are their thing, but isnt mine. Nevertheless, burger was hot and fresh, and their concretes (milkshakes) were cold snd sweet. Definitely recommend!
Great burgers and fries! Especially having veggie options :) great desserts! Good prices
Love coming to this place for burgers and fries. Always friendly service whenever I come and never had a negative experience.
Its unique!  Great chocolate shakes like you get at the old time diners

Ok with interesting twist on the everywhere burgers. Really a kids and family place even with the 1950s chrome and plastic decor. Their strong point is their offering of custards and shakes. The ordering process can be confusing at first but well organized for custom made orders and possible busy times. We need to try a few more times to enjoy the full varity of offerings.
Great place, clean and day service. Good was great! Will be back.
Friendly staff! First time there ever and enjoyed an oreo shake!
Great fast food spot. Great burgers and fries and one of the only places around to get frozen custard. A grw at stop if you're in the area.
Love this place! I only go about once every other month. I can't afford the weight!
First time here, recommend by friends, we loved the food, the shakes are amazing, and the custard was so good we will be. Back
Great custard, great service, very friendly staff.
I love the chocolate milkshakes that they have here. I haven't tried the food yet, but I hope to someday
Honestly I don't like their Burger but Custard ice cream just wowowowiwiw highly recommended
I go to Freddys for lunch often.  Friendly and fast service, tasty burgers and hot dogs.  Great value!!!
Reliably quick and good food.
Burger fries and Desserts were amazing
They always do a fantastic job!  Good food at reasonable prices and the service is great as well.

If you haven’t already ate here you’re missing out, by far the best steak burgers I’ve tried in the NOVA area.

Great service and their ice creams are also great
What a nice and welcoming NEW staff member! A young man with a wonderful sense of humor, served us at the drive through.
Freddy's rocks!
Great 50's burger joint feel (minus the car hops).  Love the shoe string fries and burgers!
I was really looking forward to the custard. The serving was large but the flavor was lacking.  I'l try it another time and see

Left my sundae at the drive-thru. Half way home I thought about it and went back. Not only did they give me my sundae, but free coupons for having missed giving it to me!  Great service and the burger was fantastic!
Friendly service, good food, thanks for the pup cup (small cup of ice cream with bone) but forgot the fry sauce i was sure to ask for twice... would have made the fries much better.
The restaurant was clean. The food was good. They mixed up my ice cream order but not a big deal. All around, it was a good experience and I would recommend it for a place to get a burger.
The best burgers and fries in Fairfax!  Plus, as if that isn't enough, they have frozen custard too.  Veteran owned....absolutely fantastic place.
Basically like a local steak and shake. Food was pretty good. Clearly this place caters towards kids, so not really my kind of place to sit and eat, though their seating is plenty

I go here all the time. There's always a bit of a wait since they make everything as soon as you order it, but the wait is well worth it. Food is fantastic, but the fries are super thin. It's all about the dessert though.
Best fast food burger. Fast, clean, friendly staff!
Love their fries and fry sauce. Food is cooked fresh for every order.
Good place to go late night.
Concretes are good, although my wife and I found out we hate steakburgers 😝
Custard was good, and service was good. My kids loved it.
One of the best burgers in town. Onion rings are delicious too. Oh and make sure to try the concrete!
Excellent burgers, friendly service, wide food selection, creamy tasty frozen custard.

Soft serve ice cream with toppings was very overpriced, ordinary and lackluster. Returned for their hamburgers, and had a better impression. Definitely a high-school hangout. Wish they would use real ice cream, maybe Gerbers or another local ice creamery.

Went through the drive-thru option on a quiet Wednesday night. There were only 2 cars ahead of me and I figured it would be a quick request. The food was delicious as usual. However, the drive-thru line could be faster since I waited over 20 minutes to get my food.

My family and I really enjoy Freddy's - Burgers, fries, and ice cream are all awesome! Last night I had the brownie shake - to die for... Only reason for 4 stars vs 5 is the feeling I have afterwards. Gut bomb, just being honest
Great burger and ice scream shop
Fantastic frozen custard. Steakburgers are great. Excellent thin and crispy fries. True original restaurant different from the mundane burger fast food joints. Hope they expand soon.
Good food friendly service
Quick service.  Yummy food.  Even the veggie burger is pretty good.

Meh. Basically a Steak N Shake, but twice as expensive and only half as good. Burger tasted burnt, fries were flavorless. Three stars because the frozen custard is good, but I probably won't go back unless I have no other options.
Never disappoints
Frozen Custard is the best. Better than average burgers, dogs, fried pickles, onion rings. Shoe string fries are average. Pleasant service.
If you want a tasty, satisfying and perfectly cooked burger, then this the place to go. Enjoy
The California Burger is the closest thing you'll get to a Double Double on this coast. The custard is super rich smooth. Worth a visit.
Very cute little restaurant great simple burgers,  fries, shakes and onion rings!
Great burgers and fries. The custard is wonderful especially the vanilla and I always choose chocolate but this vanilla is great
Good food, line was long, but it moved quickly. Would recommend

Good burger and steak burger.
Highly recommend this place but not so clean.
Excellent food, but not the fastest service.
Great service, great food for the price range
Great food and options, cheap price. Kids love the concretes
Better than any of the ‘upscale’ burger chains.
Mediocre fast food. Excellent service.
Great service and food.
Delicious custard. Mmmmm
Best ff burgers around

I came here hoping that it would be like steak & shake but sadly, it just wasn't. I didn't get any frozen custard, just a burger but couldn't finish it. It was dry and flavorless. I guess steak & shake is worth the 3 hour drive. Haha.
Good old fashion burger, fries and I've cream.
Wow! This place is delicious. I loved the food and ice cream.
good
This was a nice treat.
Always tasty and they even provide a small custard for my doggie to enjoy.
Great shakes, yummy burgers. Wish they had gluten free options for my SO.
Not to good burger half cooked or it was not fresh
Great "west coast" style burger and ice cream shop. Get the Freddy's sauce!
Good burgers and fries. And don't forget about the frozen custard!
They have really good shakes and concretes.
Nice young staff serving. Always doing a great job.
Bacon steakburger and some chili cheese fries?!?! Delicious! 🏆🏆
They were really nice to my dog and gave him ice cream. Automatic 5 stars!
Delicious steakburgers, crispy shoestring fries and a wide variety of frozen desserts. I eat here regularly.
Think steak n shake but much better. Burgers are good, fries are great, and the shakes are the whole point in going.
Excellent chili dog, wonderful shakes
Great food and friendly service. Good custard
Better version of steak and shake! Everything on the menu is great
My favorite fast food place for frozen custard. My friend keyed me into place and I've been a fan ever since. So glad they have one in Fairfax.
It's basically Steak n Shake but cleaner and better, with frozen custard. Also, worth the trip for the fry sauce alone.
Good food!
The the frozen custard is delicious.  I haven't even started exploring the rest of the menu yet.
Ok not great
Nice service and nice atmosphere with good food

After my wife and I ordered, we waited a few minutes and had our treats in hand BEFORE we were told our cost. After being told our total, I handed over my credit card and got a surprised look from the cashier. She then proceeded to tell me they are a CASH ONLY establishment (yep, in 2017 we still have one of these!). So BEWARE before coming with only plastic! Now, she did say that there was a sign on the door, which there was, but neither of us noticed it to be honest because there was other stuff to look at on the door, and also the left side of the double door was locked, so we tried that, failed to open, then tried the other side, which let us in. Now, as we are standing there, ice cream melting in hand, I ask my wife if she has cash, and of course she left her purse back at the hotel. So I told the young woman if she wouldn't mind letting me leave to go get the cash, while my wife stayed there so she knows we aren't going to rip em off. The girl frantically went back to ask her manager and got the approval. After leaving, getting the cash, driving back and paying properly, we finally were able to enjoy our evening, even though they were closing soon...I personally think they should have let us eat our ice cream and THEN leave to get the cash, but that didn't happen.

With all that said, my waffle cone WAS good and my wife enjoyed her sundae.

Ambiance: 5 Stars. This is really a perfect coffee shop to do work in, and great interior design. The tins are also aesthetic, but more about this in the bean section.

Service: 4 stars. It’s really 50/50 whether I get somebody that’s happy and excited to talk to me about the coffees available. Sometimes they can be dismissive and generally sad. For context, I usually go in around 6:30 when there is no line so I can pick out beans to take home. It’s the end of the day – you can’t expect everybody to maintain high energy. The vibe is probably different as a morning coffee shop.

Beans: 2 stars. I’ve been consistently disappointed with their beans ever since they took the “Roast Date” off their tins. Yes the tins a beautiful, but they are pushing old, oily coffee. Everything is overstocked to look beautiful, so almost nothing is fresh. The coffee is also expensive for only 12oz – you get much better value out of something like Counter Culture. They should really put the “roast date” back on the tins.

My latest bean - First Bake – was truly awful. The tin had a layer of oily sludge at the bottom because the beans were burnt to a crisp. “Dark roast” is an understatement.

Cardinal is a good medium roast – kinda hard to dial in on an espresso machine because of the oils. Since even their mediums are oily too (oils decrease as the roast gets lighter), my best guess is that they aren’t cooling the beans fast enough after the roasting process.

I’ll be looking into other roasters going forward. That being said, a great coffee shop for when you’re on the go.

Dubbed the "Greek Chipotle" by some, CAVA is a unique food journey waiting to be experienced. Upon first entering, you'll find restaurant with modern architecture, lots of stainless steel, and an eclectic mix of music playing. There is a bit of a learning curve with their menu for those new to Greek cuisine, but after a close study and a call to my cousin I was ready to roll (luckily they have menus right as you walk in so you can prepare yourself for what's ahead).

In a Chipotle-esque style, you order your bowl or pita and then move down the line selecting your greens and grains, your meats, your spreads and toppings, and then your dressing. The staff is more than willing to explain what you're looking at and to allow you to have a few different spreads, dips, and toppings. I also highly suggest some of the homemade seasonal juices and teas that they offer as they are pretty exquisite. I enjoyed my time here and will absolutely be back!

Had the double burger and it was great, fries weren’t as good but really didn’t go for the fries. Had a watermelon agave drink and it was the best watermelon drink I’ve had and Nicole was such an amazing bartender she definitely weds a raise

Burgers are very good, staff is friendly, and the atmosphere is non-standard in a good way! One vegetarian in our group complemented veggie burger especially on a lettuce "bun". Cocktails were mixed fine. Overall definitely 5 stars!

Ate lunch here.  Onion straws on burger were flour covered onions that seemed like they had been lightly sauteed.  A gross wet flour covered soggy mess.  Side fries for 2 were $5.50 and the equivalent of a fast food medium order of fries.  Burgers were flavorless.  Will not be returning.

The server was very nice.  Pictures is the Breakfast burger which includes egg, avacado, and smoked bacon.  Fries are a'la carte, and I had them tossed in old Bay as a true Washingtonian should.  Burger, fries, beer, and tip was about $32, par for the area I guess.
Good atmosphere, will return.

UPDATE:Tried online ordering only to show and be told it would be 30 more minutes, 70 minutes to make 3 burgers and 2 fries. When I questioned the staff I was just blown off, it I hadn't already paid online I would have walked out.
VERY DISAPPOINTING!!!Deduct 2 stars, one for inability to deliver on time and one for bad attitude from staff.

Decent burgers, the Oktoberfest burger (with a bratwurst on top of burger) was amazing. A little filling but delicious. You can't go wrong with any of the "FRY" alternatives but the zucchini fries are the BEST.

Actually a really good burger. Whatever they put on it, it was one of my favorite burgers ever. Nice seating by a fireplace outside. Downside is that it took 15 minutes for someone to get my drink order after I was seated. Would not recommend if you are in a hurry, but if you have time to kill, great burger!
Great social vibe. Easy bar seating. Food is savory and shakes are thick and rich.

I came here for happy hour. I arrived around 5:30 and it wasn't busy. There were 8 of us at a long table by the bar by the time I arrived. Some left before I got there. I was surprised that there wasn't a waiter or waitress assign to attend to us or the bar area. We had to order drinks and food at the bar, and it took a long time for the waitress to bring the banana cream pie to me. I had to check with the bartender. The banana cream pie was delicious. The crust was crunchy and the rest just melted in my mouth. There was chunks of banana in the pie. It was bigger than I thought and it was so easy to eat the whole thing. I will probably come back and try their food and milkshakes. I was too full to eat a meal today. The bartender was responsive and she was very professional and nice. The bar was more than half full and she worked the bar and took our drinks and food orders all by herself.  Impressive. Not having a waiter/waitress assign to our table is the only complain I have from this visit.

So.... I'm going with 4-stars because I don't really remember the food all that well. I remember I got a burger with an egg... it was delicious... but I only remember that. Now.... the shake was phenomenal. I sucked the whole thing down within minutes. They have a wonderful open atmosphere, great servers and customer service. If I lived closer, I'd be there often. You should go check this place out. I did and I don't regret it.
Some really tasty unique burgers here! Nice selection and variety to chose from, plus our food came out pretty quick which is always a plus.

Interior and exterior portions of the restaurant are kept clean as well as the public restrooms. Burger choices are plenty, and you can truly, "have it your way," if you recognize the slogan. The food arrives hot and service is significantly better than 95% of all of the established chain restaurants that have served the same menu choice for 40+ years. The menu has an interesting array of drinks for all ages and taste buds! Make sure someone at your table order the sweet potato fries and some other person orders a popular shake for sampling.

Delicious and what a bargain - drinks, apps, and a burger for under $20 at happy hour - what a great deal!  All of their food and drinks are delicious.  You can go wrong.  Great atmosphere too - live music and comfy sofas outside, with firepits to ward off the cold.  Perfect!

Not only does this place serve your standard burgers, but they have specialty ones and I had their burger of the week which was like a topless bun burger in a garlicky sauce with arugula omg it was so good. They also have AMAZING milkshakes and you can even spike them (; will be back. Bri was awesome at helping decide what to eat/drink and super sweet!
I thought the interior is too bright, but overall it was a great experience.

I had went to a Zin Burger years ago in Charlottesville and was so happy when I realized there was one in Springfield. What drove me to come here was the truffle fries (which I absolutely love) but I was so glad I ordered the Farm salad with champagne vinegarette. First off the dressing itself was AMAZING, but I loved that the salad had quinoa and chickpeas in it! I will definitely be back for this salad and fries again. My friends and I sat outside and the outdoor seating area was great!

Very very good! Excellent service. We went around lunch and the service was fast! I thought the burger was delicious until I had my milkshake. Words can't describe how delicious it was. I dream about that milkshake...

The food was good. My friends and I had lunch here about a month ago. The three-star rating is because we ordered two drinks a piece. Both of our second drinks were super super weak. We asked the pregnant bartender about it and she basically said tough luck. Our waitress was gracious enough to refund us and we left the water down drink on the table. Good customer service is simply topping us off with liquor vs. Brushing us off.. I'm the customer if I complain do something about it!

Very pricey for a burger.  $21 bill for their company burger, fries and an Ice Tea.  The burger had caramelized onions but combined with the burger meat it just has no real taste.  The burger Patty is a nice size.  The burger was cooked to order.  Just needed some more taste
Great food and a great place to catch the game
Amazing burgers. The food is all fresh and organic, you can tell the restaurant has a special place for good food

I have a designated burger spot, that is delicious and conveniently located next to my job. I'm about to abandon that spot in order to go out of my way to go to zinburger going forward.

Last night, my girl and I were served by Marcellus, and he was a cool cat. He greeted us immediately, was very efficient, and took very good care of us.

We got the crispy chicken sandwich and the Diablo burger. Both were perfect. The chicken was actually seasoned well, had flavor, and was crisped perfectly. The Diablo burger had a great amount of heat, and literally melted in your mouth. It has been a long time since I've had a burger that was both seasoned well and melted in your mouth at the same time.

The maple butter sauce that goes with the sweet potato fries is unlike anything I've had in a very long time. I will definitely go back just for the sweet potato fries and the maple butter sauce. My goal this year is to try every burger on the menu because I am confident that none of them will disappoint me.

Thanks Marcellus for making me a fan of Zinburger.

Great burgers and many options to choose from. Happy hour prices are good and runs longer then most of the other bars located there. Atmosphere is nice, option to sit outside at the bar but yet still have some of the AC cooling you.

Don't try the happy hour... Not enough bar staff, all of our food came out barely warm since no one helped them (despite other employees clearly standing around doing nothing).  Hard to judge a place with cold food and a manager who stood around chatting to employees rather than step up and help.

EDIT:  Gave them a SECOND try.. I just love punishment!  Dropped a star in rating too.  I emailed the manager, got a great response and a gift card to use.  So we went back.  Sat at the bar, not very busy again, got drinks.  I got fries which came out hot but were severely lacking in a truffle taste.  Friend wanted to order food, asked the bartender who said she'd be right back, never came back.  Was VERY attentive to the couples who sat at the inside part of the bar and her regular next to us, but just kept speeding by us or walking the other way.  Never came back.  Couldn't use the gift card on mainly alcohol either.  She never apologized for not returning even when something was said about her not returning.  Wrote back to the manager who hasn't responded in 3 weeks.  A shame as it has potential to be an awesome place, but will most likely fail.

Staff was friendly and the space was clean with a modern and welcoming decor. Food was underwhelming and under-cooked. Ordered a medium burger that came out medium-rare, leaning toward rare and generally lacked flavor. Beyond burger was also under-cooked and bland. However, the French Fries were well done and satisfying. Overall, if you are near the mall and in the mood for a burger, you'd be better served by going to BGR in the food court.

I tried the seasonal bison burger and it was really good. The shake of the month was Nutter Butter and it was AMAZING. The chef was out and about and even refilled drinks for us, which we thought was really nice.
Delicious. Burgers cooked perfectly! Fries cooked perfectly! And dipping sauces were amazing! I will definitely come back.
Burger were good but I would questions the cleanliness of the place. My feet were sliding on the floor and we sitting a booth. The bathroom was ehhh. Our server was kind and efficient.
I've been here a number of times and it never disappoints! ZB is one of the few places that will cook a burger exactly how you order it. The fries are house made and very good.

GREAT burger. It's a bit greasy but they are very flavorful. This place is not fast food. It's a high end burger at a high end price. I highly recommend it, except the pretzel chicken special. Stick with the burgers. Also you don't need to spend the extra money on the Kobe.
However, do try the tots, zucchini fries, or a dessert. The shakes and pies are more than enough for two people.
The only reason for the star reduction is because of the price, but if you don't want to over eat, take a date, split a burger and a couple of sides and dessert. You'll be plenty full at a good price.
Amazing service, burgers, and atmosphere! Tried this place out for the first time a while ago and just keep going back for more. The burgers taste fresh, made to order, and are delicious.
Delicious burger spot! When you want a real burger this is a great spot to go

I am still full! Burgers were great. We got the El Diablo burger and the Zinburger. Well cooked, and delicious. Only real downside was the bottom bunk got soggy real quick. We also had a chocolate malt, which didn't have enough malt in it, but we mentioned it to the server and she got it remade real quick! (thank you!) Then it was perfect!  Now it's time to waddle off to bed.

Oh just a note so you know: the burgers come with -just- the burger. Sides are extra (and sized to share).

Updated 10/30 - must take rating diwn to 3. Just there, for 1st x, charged 1.25 for sour cream. I said something tonour mediocre waiter who said we have to pay it. What!!! I just paid 14.25 for sn everything burger and now being charged fir a condiment. And, frie order getting less and less fries. Coleslaw same issue. Servers lacking basic skills like filling water glasses. On a Friday too. Need a break from Zinburger's. Updated Review 10/17 - service needs work. Waiters need training big time. Best burgers ever. What I like the most about this restaurant is the consistency of the food. You can depend on getting the same quality of food each time. Happy hour every weekday beginning at 5 p.m. and drinks and food items are half price. Wednesday is half off a bottle of wine and you can take the bottle home if you don't finish at the restaurant. TV'S are set to sports channels and the bar is large and quite nice and open. Outside seating available with half the bar on the outside as well. Each month they have different burger or sandwich specials.  You can sign up for a Zinburger VIP card on line, present each time you go and you receive $10 off when you spend a certain amount.
Interesting, good burgers. 5 or so beers on draft. Service has always been good. They have happy hour.
Awesome first time. Turkey and beef burger was the freshest I've ever tasted. Burgers are big too. Tater tots and fries are good. Manager was very attentive and accommodating
Very high quality burgers here as well a nice atmosphere and staff. I do like the happy hour special on burgers and beer, you can't beat it.
Amazing food at this place.  Service was phenomenal for lunchtime.  Pricier than my normal lunch stops, but I also usually don't have food this good for lunch!

Note ----  This Zinburger location is/was offering a 10% discount for anyone with a same day movie ticket.
....
Location  -- Attached to Springfield Town Center, with exterior access only.
....
Food -- Very good burgers.
....
Service -- Great.  We announced we had upcoming movie tickets and the team did a wonderful job facilitating a quick turnaround.
....
Atmosphere -- Clean. Open.  Uncluttered. However, Hard surfaces may be difficult for individuals with sound sensitivities.
....
Summary -- We like this Zinburger.

Good old american burger joint. Big burgers, so so nice. Extra nice staff and plenty of space. Definitely returning here for a few more burgers. Might try something new. Well priced and excellent kids meals.

Very interesting concept, but pulled off wonderfully. There is a huge selection of creative burgers, in addition to a rotating burger of the week, and everything I've had was delicious. Sides of loaded fries or tater tots were also wonderful. Seasonal sangrias are a great addition to the standard wine list. I do enjoy their wine flights, as it's the only place I've seen have that take on a traditionally beer-centric tasting

We sat at the bar Saturday night. We had great service !!! Bartender was honest when we asked questions and super nice! Food was awesome !!!! Burger was cooked to perfection and the chopped wedge was AMAZING!! We will definitely be going back soon :).

Some of the best burgers I've had, they might be gourmet burgers. Great service too. But the fries are a bit small. It's not cheap, but the burgers taste good enough. I've gone here for lunch on weekdays a few times and there's never a wait, not sure about evenings and weekends.

Service at Zinburger is always pleasant and professional. It's a bit loud for meaningful conversation, but aside from that, the atmosphere is great for families or friends. The burgers are consistently excellent (whether on the delicious brioche rolls or lettuce wraps) and the sides and wine selection are great.
Good food- worst service ever. Been there like 10 times and it’s always the same. My daughter loves the place so I take her.

Huge location with table service and great happy hour specials. The food is greasy and delicious, but service is not always accurate. Huge bar with seven flat screen TVs.  Easy parking in the mall lot, though it's packed on Saturday nights. Summer special is $3 meals including drink for kids! Great deal anywhere, especially here.

Huge location with table service and great happy hour specials. The food is greasy and delicious, but service is not always accurate. Huge bar with seven flat screen TVs.  Easy parking in the mall lot, though it's packed on Saturday nights. Summer special is $3 meals including drink for kids! Great deal anywhere, especially here.

Wasn’t greeted until about 10 mins after we sat at the bar. Got water which had stuff floating in it. Didn’t complain. Ordered drinks, okay. Ordered food, waited, still waiting 4 people come in we still, they all ordered food after us and got food after us. They brought out cold fries, not no burger. I could go on. The reason for the 3 was because of the food being good. However the service sucks and to wait I’ve 50 mins for just a burger and some fries. The food being good saved this review from getting a 1 star.
Gotta say my burger was Fantastic. It looked so good and was so juicy, I forgot to take a pic. I'll show you the next one.....only  if I can resist eating it first.  🙄😁😁
Great burger and awesome fries. I highly recommend you get the sweet potato waffle fries. The yogurt dipping sauce was amazing!

Pretty good burgers!  Really good wine and a wide selection.  Their beer selection is ok, at least there should be something everyone likes, but maybe not the most exotic beers.  Happy hour is from 3-6 which seemed short, but I would go back.  Not usually a wait time.
The el diablo burger is great!
Good food and good staff. Recommend their truffle fries. Delicious.
This is a high quality burger joint. The burgers come with a gluten free bun, as do some of the fries. Hooray for a fabulous gluten free burger!!!

Food is good and it is a relatively nice place. I don’t know why they do it but I am not a fan of any restaurant that isn’t full and they s at you right next to someone else. I am sure it has something to do with beaut staff sections or the software but I would prefer to not sit next to people when there are dozens of tables open.
Just not the same experience it once was. It is like the staff doesn't want to be there. Still have Evo #3 on tap, which is the only reason I ever go. And that isn't very often.
I have never been disappointed in the quality of food here. The burgers and great and the sides are amazing. This is my go to spot when I want to grab a quick bite when I'm in the area
Service was good but the burgers have lost quality.

Good burgers. The Kobe burger was good, but I'm not sure I could tell the difference from non-kobe beef. There was a mess up with my order and I didn't like the tatter tots but the management took care of it no problem.

Pretty good burgers!  Really good wine and a wide selection.  Their beer selection is ok, at least there should be something everyone likes, but maybe not the most exotic beers.  Happy hour is from 3-6 which seemed short, but I would go back.  Not usually a wait time.
The food was great. Service was subpar. We were constantly looking for our server. So many servers just hanging out in the back of the restaurant but yet the chef was bringing out our food.

Underwhelmed overall. The shake was really good, the fried zucchini was nice, but not very crispy (the batter isn't very good). The burger was undercooked and super greasy, the bacon on the burger was chewy and the bun was mushy from the grease and sauce. Pretty bad burger experience especially for the price. BGR Burgers is way better.

The salad and tater tots was good. The interior is nice, but service was polite but slow.
Great food, somewhat attentive wait staff, a bit pricey.
Excellent date night location.  Eat outside for an extra special treat.

The place is nice but the food is not that special. The description of the burger in the menu is not the same as the taste.  If you like a very greasy burger than you might like to try it. There are plenty of restaurants serving great burgers in town. For the price you pay it's not that special. Also, its overpriced.  I don't recommend it.
Best Burgers around.  This place will blow your mind.  Great food, amazing shakes, their zuccini fries are so good, and they have a great wine list.  This is our favorite for date night!!

The 4 stars is for the service. I give the food and shakes 5 stars. Every time we go here the service takes forever, they get something wrong, and it’s never busy when we are there so we never understand. The food is wonderful. I get the Kobe burger and we share the loaded fries. For dessert you have to try the butterfinger shake its to die for!
Nice place to splurge ($10-$15 hamburgers) once in a while.  Food and wine is great, the place is bright and open and airy, service is good, has big screen TVs all over showing all kinds of sports
I had the veggie burger and zucchini fries. There were very good. The server was excellent.
Love Zin burger! Atmosphere and food is awesome. Truffle fries are wonderful.
Food was good restaurant style cozy.
The burgers are always really good. The service up front was good. The hostess' were very friendly.

Great burgers. Attentive service. Class of patrons is a bit middle of road but overall good dining experience. Keep it up.

Ps I was writing this review after the burger and 5 stars. I turned to 4 stars.
Great, stylish place. Food was excellent. Good children's dining options. Carb-free menu option "wedge burger" was great.

$5 burger during happy hour and 1/2 priced drinks and sides. My burger fell apart pretty easily, making it difficult to hold and eat. Overall for the price it was right, but for full price , I wouldn't have been impressed. Also, the beers on tap could use some updating.
Usually really good. I dont know if Columbus day was understaffed or what but our service was terrible. The second star was for the alright food. Prices wrong and order wrong.

This is the premier location to get a hamburger. My plain and simple with mushrooms and swiss cheese was extremely good.

All ingredients were clean, fresh, and delectable. I was surprised on how well the flavors were apparent. I was able to taste everything. The cheese was aged, the vegetables were nice and fresh, all near-perfect.

My only quarrel was the high prices, but that was acceptable given the circumstances.

Very enjoyable, can be pricey, but overall a very nice (and delicious) experience.
Food was hot and fresh service was great I will be going back again which they had wings just burgers, chicken sandwiches ,shakes,fries and wine.
Zucchini fries and the Kobe burger are the way to go! Some notable specialty drinks are available as well, like the Jalapeno Margarita, Mango Mojito and the Kentucky Smash! Love this spot!

Pricey but good burgers. Waitress said to ask for more thorough cooking than a normal restaurant. My wife followed that advice and got an overdone burger. I ignored the advice and was happy with mine.

Food is delicious, but good luck ever getting your order taken in an even remotely reasonable time frame.  Even when they finally do show, drink orders also take forever.  Plan on what should be an hour-long meal taking 90 to 120 minutes. I've given up on this place due to the lackluster service.
One of our sorta regular spots. Good burgers. Love the zucchini and sweet potato fries. Great happy hour deals during the week.
Been here several times.  The food is always great, and the servers are nice.  My son and daughter love it, too!
First time here, food was fresh and hot milk shakes are good. Just wish they didn't get rid of the cheesecake milk shake

I WILL NEVER EAT HERE AGAIN. 3 out of the 5 times I've been here and the customer service is terrible when the guys with the big suits are not there. The first time I went was the very first week it opened and we had to wait at the table to be served longer then 15 minutes. We had to wait longer then 20 minutes to put the order in for dessert's and then we had to wait another 15 minutes in order to get the check. WTH I ended up giving the waitress 5 dollar tip but wrote on the receipt we should not have to look for our waiter. The second time I went service was great. The third time I went we were not greeted by the hostess right at all. There were some guys that came in first and there were three hostesses at the front and they sat up there flirting with the guys, having a personal conversation and didn't even acknowledge that I was standing there. Until my face got real unpleasant. The fourth time I went service was excellent and I really liked my waitress. The fifth time which was last night was horrible. I ordered a to go meal. I came and said I would like to order to go. The hostess said you have to order at the bar. I went to the bar and I got serviced pretty fast. I ordered and then she brought me this receipt that I ordered and walked away. She didn't tell me how long the wait was going to be or that I can come back and pay. I had to wait to ask her. Then I came back and I give them that they were busy so I stood there and waited and I saw my food just sitting there. The red head supervisor came to help some people and then looked me dead in my face and walked off. So, I walked off too because I thought to myself I don't have to eat here and keep waiting here. I stood there for about 8 minutes. That's crazy and customer service needs to be much better.
Zucchini fries and the Kobe burger are the way to go! Some notable specialty drinks are available as well, like the Jalapeno Margarita, Mango Mojito and the Kentucky Smash! Love this spot!
The fries we got were a little over done but this is the only visit where that happened. Burgers were awesome.
Enjoy the food and shakes. However service is always questionable. I feel like my server was a bit over self medicated for work today.

I had the Zinburger with a Kobe patty and truffle fries. While it was not the best burger I ever had, it was very good. The patty was juicy and flavor full. I paired it with the red blend wine which was also decent.
This is my favorite place to hangout with friends, eat and enjoy their decadent shakes. No reservations needed and family friendly. You always leave full and happy.

The service was incredibly slow. I was with a group of 8 for dinner. The restaurant had a lot of peoole, but not super busy. We didn't even have to wait for a group of 8 walking in. Our server seemed to be new, but he also had a guy shadowing him, we assumed to help train (although that was never said to us). I ordered a vodka soda and he asked me what kind of soda. I said soda water a little surprised and he told me defensively it could have been any kind... During our whole experience food took over 30 minutes to arrive, in the 1.5-2 hours we were there we were able to flag him down once for drink refills. We got a water refill once from another server. Half of our food came out, then a few more items, but we were missing about 2-3 sides and one person's entree after everything. Our server never came over to see how everything came out, we finally got a manager to come over and told him the problem. After a few minutes, the other items came, but they brought my friend the wrong burger. At that point she was too hungry and frustrated and just ate it. We were all so frustrated at the end of the meal and just wanted to leave rather than continue drinking there.
The food was not cheap. The drinks were not cheap. I would expect better from a place like this. That being said, the food was delicious when we finally got it, although the burgers were a bit overcooked. I understand the guy was probably new, but in a restaurant that wasn't that busy, he should have had more support and the guy who was with him, presumably training him, was less than useless. I don't think any of us will be back.

The burgers were yummy but overpriced for what you get. You end up paying $13 for a burger that's good but nothing to brag about. The burgers don't include any sides which are an additional $5-8. Honestly, the most off putting aspect of this establishment was the service. It was not busy and the service was super slow. We were never checked back up on and there was a lot of waiting around. I ended up going to the bar and sat there for about 10 minutes without any of the bartenders even acknowledging me. Out of all the restaurants at Springfield mall this is definitely one I don't plan on returning to. Try Yard House or Chuys if you want good food and drinks.

I like this place.  It has an original feel and menu along with tasty food.  I eat here whenever I’m at the Springfield Mall (I’m there a lot because of Dick’s and Target) and have never had a bad experience.

My friend took me there to say how good it was. This is my FIRST TIME to be there since I'm from Arlington downtown for many years. So, I ordered the Turkey Burger (without mayo) and grilled mushrooms topping. They're SO good, wow but they're bigger than my small mouth, ugh! I cut half of them, hee, hee, hee... After that, we got the BUTTERFINGER shake to share of us. They're so delicious, yummy! I will go there again someday when I'm in town. Ta-dah!

As an east coast chain in a mall, I didn't have very high expectations, but it was a nice day and they have a bar that opens up to the outside, so at least the environment would be pleasant.  When in Rome, I usually order what a place is known for, so I asked for a Zinburger and fries.  The burger is on brioche (ideal burger bun) and the burger itself was very tender and juicy.  The only patty that beats this is from Ray's Hell Burger.
The zinfandel sauteed onions and cheese were an excellent compliment.  The fries weren't the best I'd ever had, but they were still good.  I had a red streak cocktail (tequila, Campari, grapefruit) which was also exceptional.

I've been back a couple times since then and have been equally pleased with the food.  It is now my go-to place for a burger when I don't want to drive to Ray's in DC.  Highly recommended.

Update: I'm still going back, and now I've been to their happy hour and consumed a milkshake (salted caramel).  The happy hour deals are good.  You can get a smaller burger, though the bun is the same size.  If I want to pick a nit, I'd say the bun should match the burger size.  Don't get me wrong, the brioche bun is the gold standard of hamburger buns, but all burgers should have a bun matching the patty size.  The milkshake I had was very good, among the best I've had in the area.  Mine was too thick to drink with a straw.  This could be good or bad depending on how you like your shakes.  It is colossal, however, and way too big to have with a meal.  I only went for a "snack" so I ordered no other food, and I still was incredibly full.  I wish they offered a smaller size for less money so I could get it with a meal or at least an appetizer.
Awesome food. Good price. Great service!
The food was amazing, staff was really helpful, it is kinda pricey in my opinion but food was worth it

Zin's milkshake brings this boy to the yard- and that's about it. Chicken sandwich is better than most places. Hate the fries, like the onion rings. Service is horrible. Order was wrong, tables were dirty, staff didn't care.

The burgers were yummy but overpriced for what you get. You end up paying $13 for a burger that's good but nothing to brag about. The burgers don't include any sides which are an additional $5-8. Honestly, the most off putting aspect of this establishment was the service. It was not busy and the service was super slow. We were never checked back up on and there was a lot of waiting around. I ended up going to the bar and sat there for about 10 minutes without any of the bartenders even acknowledging me. Out of all the restaurants at Springfield mall this is definitely one I don't plan on returning to. Try Yard House or Chuys if you want good food and drinks.
They have great gluten free burgers! 🙃

We come here at least once a month as a family, with friends or even a night out. The burgers and milkshake are great. Happy hour specials and Wine fights make it great place to hang out after work and have appetizers and a drink.

Ordered the Zinburger with Applewood Bacon, Zucchini Fries and the special of the day's Koren Fried Chicken. Burger and fries were good. The chicken sandwich will never be ordered again. Excellent service however.
Great service with an even better menu. I would recommend the Kobe beef style burger with one of their amazing milk shakes.
Delicious quality burgers with a great happy hour menu

Amazing grass-fed burgers and the cheese fries were great too. Our waitress was amazing but the hostesses all seemed annoyed we showed up (maybe they were just new and forgot to smile).
A little pricier than your average fare but well worth it.
Service was better than expected. The food was really good. I'd go back.

I enjoyed my dinner tonight. I had the grilled chicken buffalo sandwich which was good. With a side of mac and cheese....it was perfect. Cheesey and the panko crust made it perfect. I also had the blackberry lemonadr...yum! Mr had a burger and asked for it to be medium...it came out perfect. Not too many places can get that right. We popped in around 1pm and the place was just starting to clear out a bit from their lunch crowd. There was no wait at all and we were immediately seated by the hostess. Likewise our server was there immediately to drop off menus and silverware and take our drink order. He returned a couple moments later with the drinks and a basket of corn muffins.

I ordered the Pork Shoulder BBQ Sandwich. It comes with 2 sides so I added Fries and Collards. Mom ordered the same except she had the Sweet Potato fries with her meal. After a short wait, our lunches arrived. I had warned Mom that it was going to be a lot of food and while she was expecting a big lunch she wasn't prepared for the sheer size of her sandwich.

The BBQ as always was delicious. I finished my meal, Mom ate about half of hers and boxed the rest. We also tucked the remaining corn muffins in her box. We were in and out of there in about an hour and back out to the car dealerships after that.

All in all, a great visit. Pros: Friendly, Clean, Fast Service, Great Food. Cons: None. If you're yearning for some BBQ, check them out if you're in Yorktown or Hampton.

I came here twice while staying in town for company travel. I came in the first time on a Thursday evening to a crowded parking lot, but no wait. I came back the next day, Friday, for lunch. The restaurant had obviously just opened and there were very few people in the restaurant. The wait staff sat me immediately and were quick to get my order. I was disheartened to find out my favorite beer, Yuengling, was not available on tap despite the menu option that it was served as a draft. Turned out there were a few 'draft' beers that were bottle only. I ordered a Boston Lauger instead. I then ordered my meal, a 12oz prime rib, grilled mushrooms, and rice pilaf. The food can out in about 15-20 minutes and I was quite impressed. The steak, a 3/4 inch cut, was cooked to a perfect medium and had lots of flavor! But it was the mushrooms that grabbed my attention. They came on a skewer and had been glazed with a wine (marsalla?) making them juicy, flavorful, and the absolute highlight of the meal! The rice pilaf was okay, not much flavor, very bland.
Overall, I'm glad I gave them a second chance. The service turned out to be excellent (the second time) and the food was very good and well prepared, a bargain at the price on the menu!
I would definitely come back again.

This is one of the few times when I regretted listening to the advice of a few people regarding trying out a new place to eat. But I went out on a leap of faith, drove 15 miles down I 95 South to see what the big rave about this place called Logans Roadhouse was all about. After arriving inside, i was none too impressed. Here is my review...

The Good:

Hospitality- Upon walking towards the entrance of the restaurant, the hostess opens the door for guests and greets them properly. I arrived there shortly after 12:00pm, so since there was no crowd, I was seated immediately. The server was very friendly, knowledgeable of the menu and other servers would visit the table to make conversation here and there.

The Bad... Everything else

What A Rip Off- This place tries too hard to mimic Texas Roadhouse.  My thing is if you are going to rip off someones style, at least to a better job at it.  They have the endless bucket of peanuts on each table, most of the items on the menu are the same as Texas Roadhouse and they play the exact same type of music. The only ways in which this restaurant is different from Texas Roadhouse style wise is the servers dancing and type of butter being served with the bread. At Texas Roadhouse, there are points throughout the day where the servers will stop everything they are doing, form a line in the middle of the restaurant and start line dancing. Thankfully the servers at Logans did not do that. Texas Roadhouse also serves Cinnamon butter with a basket of four rolls, while Logan's serves regular butter with a basket of two rolls.

The Food- I ordered the Wood grilled Salmon, Mac n Cheese and Loaded Baked Potato. I believe the meal came out to be $15. I bring up the price because I did not receive a meal worth $15. The wait to get my food was 35 minutes, which would have been excusable of the food was hot or the restaurant was full, but neither was the case. Upon receiving my food, the lack of steam coming from my plate let me know that my food had been sitting somewhere for some time and was allowed to get lukewarm. I also noticed something odd about the Mac n Cheese I ordered. Granted it is a chain restaurant, I did not expect them to serve Kraft Mac n Cheese as one of their sides. Luke warm Kraft Mac n Cheese to be exact. That bowl of Mac n Cheese is something I used to make in Middle School when I was hungry and decided to whip out a pack of the instant Kraft Mac N cheese. You know, the kind you had to add either milk or water to the dry sauce and noodles. But even with that being said, the Salmon was had a lack of seasoning and the Loaded Sweet Potato was not as sweet as it could have been. To give a better perspective of things, I could have ordered the same meal from Texas Roadhouse and received better food for a smaller cost.

The Ultimate Deception- For dessert, Logan's offers a Mini trio for $5+ or the individual mini for $2.50. Eating the mini desserts that O'Charleys have to offer for a lower price plus seeing a picture of the mini dessert made me think "hey, maybe this mini might be worth a shot".  After receiving the mini dessert, I had been had, been took, hoodwinked, bamboozled, lead astray and run a muck. The mini dessert was big enough for two small bites. To put it in economical terms, I could have gotten a half gallon of ice cream and Duncan Hines brownie mix for the same cost as the mini dessert.

Summary: If an experience at a restaurant was solely judged on hospitality and service, then this restaurant would receive 5 stars. But after hearing so much hype about the restaurant, to drive 15 miles, wait 35 mins for a lukewarm bland dish and get duped on a dessert that did not have much flavor, if there was a way to give this review 0 stars, I would. ONE STAR
